description: From a humble port, you set out to clean the ocean of troublemakers. Hack and harpoon through absurd foes, shady allies, and your own bad calls. The world wants a hero… your friends want you to punch an orca. Both valid. Choose wisely—or don’t. The sea remembers everything.

name: Hogwarts Legacy: Onyx Hippogriff Mount
description:
This includes: the Onyx Hippogriff Mount.

Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action RPG set in the world first introduced in the Harry Potter books. Embark on a journey through familiar and new locations as you explore and discover magical beasts, customize your character and craft potions, master spell casting, upgrade talents and become the wizard you want to be.

Experience Hogwarts in the 1800s. Your character is a student who holds the key to an ancient secret that threatens to tear the wizarding world apart. Make allies, battle Dark wizards, and ultimately decide the fate of the wizarding world. Your legacy is what you make of it. Live the Unwritten.

name: LEGO Horizon Adventures
description:
LEGO Horizon Adventures is an action-adventure game developed by Guerrilla Games and Studio Gobo, blending the Horizon series setting with LEGO-style visuals and humour.
Players follow a retelling of Aloy’s story as she travels across a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by machine creatures. Gameplay includes exploration, combat, puzzle-solving, and cooperative play.

name: Cairn
description: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

name: Slay the Princess: The Pristine Cut
description:
Slay the Princess is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel with dramatic branching, light RPG elements, and hand-penciled art.

The Pristine Cut is the definitive version of the game. It features expanded content including 3 new chapters, never-before-seen Princesses, expansions to familiar routes, a new ending, over 1,200 new hand-penciled frames, over 2,500 new lines of dialogue, and over 35% more content overall.

name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
description:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.

name: Caution Ahead: Part 2
description:
This is the second installment of a three-part series featuring a run-and-hide type horror experience, with each part consisting of three chapters.

You follow the story of John Rand, an experienced search and rescue officer stationed at Richburg National Park.

After the events of Part I, John continues his relentless search and rescue mission. He must venture further into the depths of Richburg National Park before it's too late to save both Michelle and Elena.

* Chapter 4: The search.
* Chapter 5: Run for your life.
* Chapter 6: Almost there.

name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

name: Mixtape
description: Mixtape is a narrative adventure game developed by Beethoven & Dinosaur and published by Annapurna Interactive. Set during the last night of high school, it follows three friends as they revisit memories connected to music, youth and leaving home. The game combines story scenes with playable vignettes, including skating, parties, and other moments, all framed by a licensed soundtrack.

name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
description: Max Caulfield, photographer-in-residence at the prestigious Caledon University, discovers her closest new friend Safi dead in the snow. Murdered. To save her, Max tries to Rewind time – a power she’s not used in years… Instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive and still in danger! Max realizes the killer will soon strike again – in both versions of reality. Only Max can Shift between the two parallel timelines to solve and prevent the same murder.

name: Ale Abbey
description: Build and expand your monastery, craft recipes and brew holy ales in this unique brewery tycoon. No pre-made recipes in Ale Abbey, oh no. It's a canvas for true beer alchemists. It's as simple as: brew, sip, repeat. Welcome to Ale Abbey!

name: Pac-Man World 2
description: The black label edition of Pac-Man World 2 on the PS2 is the original North American release. It differs significantly from later versions, which were rebalanced to reduce the difficulty.

name: Soul Blade
description:
The console version of Soul Edge adds more content to the original arcade game such as new characters and additional game modes.

Added features
- The inclusion (besides the standard "Arcade" mode) of "VS", "Survival", "Team Battle", "Time Attack" and "Training" modes.
- A new RPG-styled mode called "Edge Master Mode".
- Seven extra weapons per character, which have different designs and statistics.
- The original ten selectable characters received a new PlayStation-exclusive costume.

name: Before Your Eyes
description: Embark on an emotional award-winning adventure where you control the story—and affect its outcomes—with your real-life blinks. In this unique VR experience, you will fully immerse yourself in a world of memories, both joyous and heartbreaking, as your whole life flashes before your eyes.

name: Tekken 2
description: The console version of Tekken 2, which adds more content to the original arcade game, such as new characters and additional game modes.

name: AneeMate
description:
AneeMate is a PvPvE creature extraction shooter where survival means more than just staying alive—you must rescue, evolve, and fight for the future of the AneeMates. Built in Unreal Engine 5, this high-intensity adventure blends exploration, combat, and AI-driven strategy, creating a dynamic and unpredictable battleground.

Explore, Catch, Level Up—Decide the Fate of AneeMates

name: Tekken 3
description:
The console version of Tekken 3, which adds more content to the original arcade game, such as new characters and additional game modes.

With hidden features, faster gameplay, and new characters, the PlayStation version of Tekken 3 seeks to give you the fight of your life.

name: Fantasian Neo Dimension
description:
The father of Final Fantasy, Hironobu Sakaguchi, and renowned composer Nobuo Uematsu return to deliver an original RPG story. Experience an enhanced version of FANTASIAN, initially released for Apple Arcade in 2021, with brand-new features, including English and Japanese voiceovers and an additional difficulty option.

In FANTASIAN Neo Dimension, assume the role of Leo as he journeys to recover his memories and solve the mystery of a strange mechanical infection destroying his world.

Experience an original and modern take on the beloved turn-based battle system, with a wealth of unique mechanics and strategic combat that shake up the classic RPG formula, and explore a multi-dimensional universe come to life, set against the backdrop of over 150 charming hand-crafted dioramas.

name: Mio: Memories in Orbit
description: MIO: Memories in Orbit is a 2.5D side-scrolling metroidvania platformer. Players control a robot named Mio who explores a vast spaceship called the Vessel, gaining new abilities such as wall climbing, dodging, grappling, and gliding while fighting machines that have gone rogue. Combat emphasizes aerial fighting, and players can equip modifiers that adjust their abilities at the cost of modifier slots. Currency called Nacre is used to purchase upgrades and is lost on death, and fast-travel devices serve as save points across the ship.

name: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake
description: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

name: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection
description: EUREKA! Miles Edgeworth moves beyond the courtroom and straight to the crime scene in Ace Attorney Investigations Collection with revamped graphics, new language options, bonus features, and more! Featuring two remastered titles - Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth and the Western debut of Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit - it's a perfect package.

name: Cassiculus
description: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals.

name: Falling With Ice Phoenix!
description: Falling with Ice Phoenix! combining the classic gravity fall platformer, sprited and high-octane action game, you and the cutie monster girls venture downwards to find the lost orb, facing traps and sexy monster lords ahead, an exciting adventure to the unknown lays ahead...

name: KittyToy
description: Take care of and adopt stray kitties. Buy toys and decorations for your house and yard!

name: Omega No Sunshine 2
description:
Omega No Sunshine , second game of the title, is an arcade collecthation game where players have to travel through different places in order to collect sun rings. Humanity is destroying their own world and an another time, it need someone able to collect them all and restore the sun to shine again.

This title was delisted and later republished in 2025 as a new release and self-published by Galoxyum with ongoing updates and features.

name: The Occultist
description: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

name: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster
description: Dead Rising returns with modern graphics! More than just a remaster, this Deluxe Remaster is a full graphical overhaul of the first game in zombie-slaughtering action game series "Dead Rising." This remaster has also been fully voiced, supports auto-saves, and has various other quality-of-life features. Witness the unmatched mayhem and freedom for yourself!

name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2: New Game Plus Update
description: A free patch update for Marvel's Spider-Man 2 adding New Game+, Mission Replay Mode, new accessibility features and new suits.

name: Penumbra Lane
description: Penumbra Lane is a point-and-click adventure horror game in which you play as a depressed cat-man named Xavier, who is attempting to break the lease for his new apartment.

name: Au Revoir
description: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Alley Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Alley Cat," you control a clever alley cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop goal.
The gameplay centres on precise jumps, avoiding (possible) obstacles, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can, reach the rooftop, and beat the game.

name: Toree's Panic Pack
description: Toree's Panic Pack is a collection of three tiny 3D Platformer games in a classic low poly aesthetic: Toree Genesis, Toree Jumbled Jam 2, and Toree Missions.

name: EA Sports FC 25
description: EA SPORTS FC 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed - Costume Pack
description:
The Official Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed Costume Pack, including 3 nostalgic Mickey Mouse costumes to try on and start adventuring across the fantastical world of Wasteland!

Included in the Costume Pack:
- Steamboat Willie
- Brave Little Tailor
- Football

name: Nullstar: Solus
description: Be. Faster. You are a corporate scavenger drone, sent to rip through the decaying corpse of a dying world to salvage its nullstar. Master flight, thrusters, and face ancient guardians and hazards in 80 precision platformer levels set in the ruins of a civilization where all is not as it might seem.

name: Katawa Shoujo
description: A censored Steam release of the romantic visual novel set in the fictional Japanese Yamaku High School for disabled children. Hisao's congenital heart defect forces him to move to a new school. Despite his difficulties, Hisao is able to find friends—and perhaps love, if he plays his cards right.

name: Toree Missions
description: 24 small but tight challenges that use the traditional 3D Platformer Gameplay of Toree in unique and new ways to give a final spin to the known formula.

name: Toree Jumbled Jam 2
description: Four levels that remix the themes seen in Toree 2 in new and interesting ways. Including some new chiptunes as well as some old songs. Worth mentioning: Those challenges are only for those who really know how to handle Toree! Hard as a beak!

name: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+
description: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+ is a dungeon-crawling shoot-'em-up that's literally a different game each and every time you play it! The randomly generated maps are built with over 11,000 unique room configurations, each populated with a nearly endless variety of enemies, items, challenges and secrets!

name: Duskfade
description: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

name: Floor 9: Beginning
description: In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as "Hotel Liminal." To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes.

name: Azooma Escape
description: Hide. Dodge flying slippers. Avoid that "ONE" uncle determined to feed you. Your mission: escape Uncle's celebration alive and unfed. This culturally rich stealth comedy follows an introverted teen fleeing the world's most persistent hospitality. Can you survive the family gathering?

name: The Sunday
description: The Sunday is a short walkthrough horror game where the idea of being alone will hunt you, until the drakness settles in your brain. The line between reality and nightmare is razor thin.

name: The Shuddering
description: Lose yourself in a lonely entity's embrace...

name: Goooool!
description: Have you ever tried playing cards with a bear? But bears don't know how to play cards... That in this incredible game you will feel yourself in the role of a bear who is trying to play cards, but he does not succeed. All he can do is smash everything around and scream Goooool!

name: Fate/Hollow Ataraxia Remastered
description: Remaster of Fate/hollow ataraxia, a Japanese visual novel game and the sequel to Fate/stay night.

name: Farming Supermarket Simulator
description: Embark on a relaxing but challenging journey to run your own supermarket. Grow organic plants, take care of your animals and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you turn your supermarket into an empire?

name: Homeless
description: Beneath the dazzling lights of New York, a sinister darkness lurks. In the hour when the whole city is sleeping, a strange and terrifying man emerges from the darkness, intent on shattering your mind and spirit

name: DevilConnection
description: "Shall we do something immoral?" A demon-teasing adventure where you summon unique kemono and gather magical powers to restore the naughty demon "Debirun's" form!

name: He is Coming
description: He Is Coming is a roguelite auto battler where you have to collect and combine powerful items in order to defeat the demon king and his minions. Upgrade your weapon, discover hidden treasures and survive, because whether you're prepared or not, he is coming!

name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
description: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

name: Gunzle
description: Gunzle is a game made in 3 days for the Nonejam 9. In the game you control Clover and you have to use your gun to pass trought the levels and reach the stars. As the game jam theme was genre mix the game is a mix of Gun and Puzzle.

name: Sticky Business: Camp Zinnias
description: With a vibe that mixes the energy of Camp Rock with the tenderness of Heartstopper, Sticky Business: Camp Zinnias is a lighthearted yet profound coming-of-age tale.

name: Daemonologie
description: A remake of the short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials in Unreal Engine 5. You play the role of a witchfinder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.

name: Two Point Museum
description: Curate and manage incredible museums! Explore to discover amazing artifacts. Design and refine the layout, keep staff happy, guests entertained, donations plentiful… and children off the exhibits.

name: Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra
description: This brand‑new title is a battle arena game that will divide players into teams of four and have them fight it out! You can take part in exhilarating battles where you overwhelm your opponents and enjoy amazing teamwork with your allies!

name: Revenge of the Savage Planet
description: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

name: Borderlands 4
description: See if you have what it takes to go down in history as a legendary Vault Hunter as you search for secret alien treasure, blasting everything in sight.

name: Dying Light: The Beast
description: Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land is a new enhanced version of the game that includes the base game, all previously released updates and the premiere Restored Land content in one package. This includes Legend Levels, New Game+, Ray Tracing, Nightmare Mode, dozens of new brutal finishers, hundreds of parkour and gameplay improvements, and numerous visual and audio enhancements - delivering new ways to experience the apocalypse.

name: Reanimal
description: The creators of Little Nightmares I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

name: A Shrimpful Adventure
description:
A Shrimpful Adventure is a free short 2D puzzle-platformer developed in under four days for GMTK 2024 by a small team with minimal game development experience.

"Two shrimps, a father and a child, embark on an adventure in search of treasure."

name: Herdling
description: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

name: Mafia: The Old Country
description:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

name: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker
description: This Sea of Stars DLC finds the Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale venturing into the miniature clockwork world of Horloge. In this magical land where denizens are threatened by a cursed carnival, our heroes will need to adapt to unfamiliar rules if their Sun and Moon powers are to manifest.

name: Pico Park 2
description: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

name: Tales of Graces F Remastered
description: Tales of Graces f Remastered is an action RPG with high-speed battles that allow you to switch between fighting styles to match your play style. The remastered title adds more than 80 DLC packs and items release for the original and features stunning visuals, newly localized scenes available in English for the first time, and notable quality of life enhancements such as auto-save.

name: Talking Tom 3 in Olympics
description:
Talking Tom 3 in Olympics was a Chinese bootleg mobile game that was based on "Talking Tom" app that was developed by NanJing oooo3d in 2012. The game was mostly a clone of the regular Talking Tom app, which had the player talk to Tom and he would repeat back what the player had said. In addition to that, it also featured 2 mini-games, which were milk and study.

The game notably contained the malware "Gooligan" within it, which installed rootkits and stole authentication tokens from Android devices to gain access to Google accounts, among many things. In 2013, the game was removed from the Google Play Store after the developers were sued by Outfit7 for copyright infringement.

name: Something Is Wrong With My World Map
description:
"Something is wrong with my World Map" is a puzzle game, where you need to play with various sizes in the world map in order to create the right path to continue.

Switch size by exiting a village on a different side, or even by simply opening the map!

Step on a mountain to flatten it, or switch to the small size to enter caves!

Will you "step up" to the challenge?

name: Astroneer: Glitchwalkers
description:
Travel to the Aeoluz system in pursuit of a grand threat in Astroneer: Glitchwalkers.

The Glitchwalkers DLC is our first ever expansion to Astroneer, offering a new space to explore as well as new narrative, gameplay, and mysteries to uncover.

name: Star Wars Outlaws: Wild Card
description:
In the Star Wars Outlaws: Wild Card narrative expansion, keep exploring the world of Star Wars Outlaws with an all-new story, quests, and areas to discover.

Kay is hired to infiltrate a high-stakes sabacc tournament, but as she crosses paths with the notorious gambler Lando Calrissian, she soon learns that another game is being played.

name: Star Wars Outlaws: A Pirate's Fortune
description:
In Star Wars Outlaws: A Pirate's Fortune, keep exploring the world of Star Wars Outlaws with an all-new story, quests, and areas to discover.

The Trailblazer’s reputation precedes Kay as she runs into veteran pirate Hondo Ohnaka, who is looking to settle old scores with a ruthless gang of pirates.

name: Fragrant Story and Papaya's Path
description: Smells like trouble! This tactical RPG puts a new spin on the classic genre, with characters from Otosan guided by Rhubarb and Papaya

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Midnight Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Midnight Cat," you control a clever cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop.
The gameplay centres on jumps, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can and reach the rooftop.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Drizzle Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Drizzle Cat," you control a clever cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop.

The gameplay centers on jumps, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can and reach the rooftop.

name: Mega Man 15: The Robot Apocalypse
description:
This game was made to celebrate Mega Man's franchise and delve deep into its rich history and legacy. This is a turn-based RPG with a lot of difficulty options so even if you don't like turn-based, you can just breeze through its rich new story!

Here you control four heroes who are fated to fight against a evil scientist named Doctor Wily and his evil robots that are destroying the city and breaking Space-Time itself!

Fight iconic enemies, bosses, find many easter eggs, collect mysterious items and uncover new events that connects different timelines.

name: VHScape
description:
You find yourself trapped in a haunted VHS rental store, can you survive their twisted games and escape?

A short horror-themed walking simulator and memory game inspired by our memories of VHS stores and by similar anomaly games, with an average play time of 1-4 hours.

name: Bishi Bashi Special
description:
Bishi Bashi Special is a compilation (and conversion) of the Konami arcade titles Bishi Bashi Champ, Super Bishi Bashi Champ and Handle Champ.

Gameplay is made up of tons of mini games, all of which use a simple 3-button interface that mimics the arcade originals. The mini games encompass a wide variety of button-mashing, timing and button combination games. The games themselves can be anything from making hamburgers, throwing a pie down a church aisle to balancing a car on a floating narrow gravel road and much more.

The game can be played alone, vs a computer player or play up to eight people using a multi-tap and three controllers.

name: Overflower
description: Strategically merge flowers in the pot to score more points, but be careful to keep the balance in check!

name: Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered
description: Experience the critically acclaimed Horizon Zero Dawn with stunning new visuals and upgraded features. In a far future where colossal machines roam the Earth, pockets of humanity survive in unique tribes among the lush, overgrown ruins of our long-lost civilization.

name: Calculate It
description: We've made a calculator roguelike! Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, where each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

name: Battlefield 6
description:
Battlefield 6 is a first-person shooter featuring a single-player campaign and team-based online multiplayer. Players fight as infantry or operate military vehicles across large-scale battlefields, using class-based squad roles, environmental destruction, and a range of weapons and equipment.

The game also includes Battlefield Portal, a toolset for creating and sharing custom multiplayer experiences.

name: Astro Bot: Stellar Speedway
description:
Free DLC that brings new speedrun levels and bots to rescue. It has weekly release schedule:

- Oct 17: Building Speed
- Oct 24: Let it Slide
- Oct 31: Spring-loaded Run
- Nov 7: Helium Heights
- Nov 14: Rising Heat

Each new level offers two brand-new Special Bots for you to rescue.

name: The Midnight Walk
description:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

name: Ghost of Yotei
description:
The game takes place 300 years after Ghost of Tsushima. Set in the lands surrounding Mount Yōtei, a towering peak in the heart of Ezo, an area of Japan known as Hokkaido in present day.

The area is outside the rule of Japan, and filled with sprawling grasslands, snowy tundras, and unexpected dangers.

name: Lust Shards
description: An 18+ visual novel by MindOfFur. Each route contains interesting stories, multiple endings, and depending on your choices, intimate encounters.

name: Bokura: Planet
description: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores new possibilities in cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

name: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Safe Haven
description:
Brace yourself for the darkest chapter yet in the epic Poppy Playtime saga.

You are pushed deeper into the undiscovered depths of the Playtime Co. factory, far below anything the world knew. Here, you’ll encounter terrifying new threats and discover shocking revelations. Can you outwit the unnatural new creations lurking in the shadows? Can you survive here long enough to eventually unravel the mysteries behind the experiments? Every step will test your courage, every puzzle will challenge your mind, and every corner may be your last.

Will you escape the horrors hidden within Playtime Co., or will you succumb to the terror? Survival isn’t guaranteed. Fear is.

name: Animal Company
description: Enter the chaotic and fun world of Animal Company, where survival meets pure chaos in this multiplayer VR adventure. Whether you’re exploring eerie environments, customizing your character in the Lab, or braving the terrors that await you and your friends, the excitement never stops. With weekly updates, there’s always something fresh to experience.

name: Egg Squeeze
description: Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.

name: La Ruota Della Sfortuna: Prima parte
description:
"You've received a strange message (an MMS... yes, you read that right) from your uncle, and you've just arrived at his house to find out what happened.

Strangely, all the lights are off, and the front door is open.

The situation worries you a bit, but you gather your courage—your uncle might be in danger.

You turn on your phone's flashlight and step inside..."

"La Ruota Della Sfortuna - Prima parte" is the first part of the game. It was created to participate in the ITALOCURSO Game Jam 2024."

name: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
description: Hidden Cats in Tokyo is a hidden object adventure game where you must vaccinate all the cats in Tokyo before they turn into dangerous monsters. Collect cards of heroes, monsters, and cat things. Join the adventure and fight the huge monster with your giant robot in this fun hidden object game!

name: Pathologic 3
description: Pathologic 3 is a psychological horror game in which you play Daniil Dankovsky, a rationalist doctor trying to defeat death itself as the same doomed town collapses around him. It is a standalone follow-up to Pathologic 2 and a reimagining of the Bachelor route from the original Pathologic, rather than a direct sequel or prequel. Its major new distinction is time manipulation: the premise remains a 12-day plague crisis, but the Bachelor can revisit and alter key events, reflecting his obsession with control, causality, and conquering death.

name: Webfishing
description: Webfishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

name: Silent Surveillance
description: Silent Surveillance is a horror puzzle game where you monitor multiple security cameras to find anomalies. Stay vigilant—you wouldn't want to succumb to the lurking terror waiting for a single moment of distraction. Can you survive the night?

name: Sunderfolk
description: Sunderfolk is an online and couch co-op turn-based tactical RPG where one to four players adventure together through the magical and dangerous Sunderlands.

name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Deluxe Edition
description:
Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Learn and master an incredible roster of playable characters, each with signature abilities, transformations, and techniques. Unleash the fighting spirit within you and take the fight to arenas that crumble and react to your power as the battle rages on.

The Deluxe Edition includes:

• Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO
• Season Pass - 3 Packs including Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero and Dragon Ball Daima content that contains more than 20 playable characters
• Season Pass Bonus - Summon Shenron and 3 Days Early Access to the 3 DLC Packs

name: Carry The Glass
description:
Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer!
Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges.
Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles.
Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

name: Super Mining Mechs
description: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

name: Turbo Dismount 2
description: Turbo Dismount 2 is a comedy physics racing sandbox with Mr. Dismount and his friends. It is the officially ambitious sequel to the wildly popular, immensely successful, world-renowned entertainment juggernaut - Turbo Dismount.

name: Lovish
description: Lovish is an outrageous 8-bit action-adventure game! Quest with Sir Solomon through a series of bite-sized rooms, as he attempts to free Princess Tsuna, the woman he loves, from the Devil Lord's clutches!

name: Cronos: The New Dawn
description: Cronos: The New Dawn is a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game that throws you into the heart of a deadly struggle against overwhelming foes, all while uncovering the mysteries of a twisted time travel story.

name: Subnautica 2
description: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Spooky Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Spooky Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Halloween-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

name: Tsunagari Chess School
description: A psychological horror game taking place in a Japanese chess school. Get to know the girls, go on dates, and prepare for the worst.

name: Kingdom Hearts: Card Struggle - Spider Solitaire
description:
Kingdom Hearts Card Struggle -Spider Solitaire- is a mini-game application available through Kingdom Hearts Mobile. It is a Kingdom Hearts-themed version of the card game Spider.

Kingdom Hearts Card Struggle -Spider Solitaire- was released on January 22, 2009. It was discontinued on April 30, 2013 along with the rest of Kingdom Hearts Mobile.

name: MindsEye
description: MindsEye is an ever-expanding gameplay experience with a story campaign, endless stream of new playable content delivered regularly, and the power to create your own games with the simple to use building tool.

name: Sonic Generations
description: A time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

name: Jill O' Lantern
description:
A slasher satire visual novel where the Final Girl, Vivian Finala, teams up with the monster, Jack Headed Jill, to find out who really killed everyone on Lake Shish Kabob.

Make choices, investigate crime scenes, and meet a cast of queer and colorful characters!

name: Apple Climbers
description:
Apple Climbers is a hand based locomotion game featuring the wonderful fruit, apples!

It's a simple game, but with a big twist! Instead of moving normally with your thumbstick, you have to move with your controllers!

name: Horror High
description:
HORROR HIGH is a '90s horror/comedy 4v1, competitive survival, open-map RPG.
Up to four high school stereotypes face iconic monsters as they attempt to survive and escape.

Journey around the expansive town of Creepertin as you gave weapons, health, flashlights, and key items you'll need to rebuild long-abandoned vehicles and flee to safety. Or, team up and try to take down your pursuer!

name: Ratshaker
description: RATSHAKER is the fun and quirky solution to all your rat problems! Hold on to the RAT, shake your arm, and watch life’s problems disappear! How far can you go?

name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
description: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ delivers the ultimate, feature-complete, randomized dungeon-crawling experience, now enhanced with full online co-op for up to four players. It integrates all previous DCs and content updates, featuring 700+ items and over 300 enemy types. Key features include new online leaderboards, an emote wheel, and refined multiplayer systems.

name: Paperhead Ep. 0
description: In this cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... You wake up in a prison cell. A strange voice calls to you from the depths of dark corridors covered in runic symbols and blood. Reload your trusty shotgun and find out... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

name: Awaria
description: Welcome to the tunnel maintenance crew. If the generators fail, it's your job to fix them. Check what's wrong, craft all the needed parts and deliver them. It's simple. Just stay clear of anything that randomly cracks bolts of electricity, spews fire, throws sharp pieces of scrap at high-velocity or radiates with ominous green light.

name: Nightmare Shift
description: Nightmare Shift is a psychological horror game that follows a female protagonist who starts a new job as a motel receptionist, only to find her life spiraling into a dark and mysterious reality. As she questions her sanity, she must uncover the truth behind the eerie and abnormal events around her.

name: The Last Nurse Joy
description: In Pokémon, when battles don’t swing in your favor or the journey becomes too grueling, the Nurse Joys and their peculiar machines are always there to ensure the game continues seamlessly. Transforming a Pokémon from a state of injury to complete stability might seem like sorcery. Yet, this magic is seldom questioned. But remember, even magic has its origins. There was a time when this miraculous machine was non-existent, and somewhere, a Nurse Joy was the last to receive it.

name: Schoolgirl Supervisor: Saori Sato
description: You are taking control of the Japanese high-school girl Saori Sato who has just become the Supervisor of Sayama Highschool and is respectful referred as Officer Sato.

name: Gauntlet Legends
description:
The third and final console version of Gauntlet Legends, released in June of 2000.

This version is most notable for being a near-direct arcade port, as the only console port to feature the four original Realms from the arcade original. However, some of their levels were completely redone, a new physics engine was used, and some of the soundtracks were remixed.

Like the arcade version, there is no inventory. The player can only access the shop after completing a level. Special items are used on a time limit, which is slightly longer than the arcade version. The game is often criticized for not allowing players to buy food at the shop.

This port includes many features from Gauntlet: Dark Legacy, including its 8 new character classes. The Poisoned Fields area is included as the first level in the Castle Stronghold. The Mausoleum is also accessible from a secret passage in the Castle Courtyard.

name: Of Ash and Steel
description: Of Ash and Steel is an immersive third-person open-world RPG created by a passionate team that values the essence of classic old-school RPGs and modern designs. Explore the lands of a once-prosperous island, hone your combat skills, and survive in the unforgiving realm of the Kingdom of the Seven.

name: A Night Duty
description: It is an upcoming horror game developed in South Korea. The player can simulate a night duty as an officer in Korean army base. It is a game that inspired by the game The Exit 8.

name: Half Away
description:
Half Away is a One-Shot Narrative adventure where you play as Juna, exploring a mystical Spirit Realm.

Use her unique ability to hear hidden voices to solve puzzles and interact with enchanted objects and spirits.

Discover secrets, face challenges, and uncover multiple endings in this magical journey filled with exploration, puzzle-solving, and storytelling.

name: Beyond Citadel
description: Beyond Citadel is an anime style retro throwback shooter inspired by the classics of the 90's, with realistic gunplay mechanics, anime violence and fast paced combat. Fight your way through the heavily armed mechanical fortress and discover the secret that lies beneath.

name: Final Fantasy I+II Premium Package
description: This Japanese special edition includes two enhanced PlayStation ports of the first two Final Fantasy games with commemorative figures.

name: Vault
description: Uncover the story of a mysterious island through the lens of a primitive drone as you search for the artifact concealed within it, and avoid the guardian of the island.

name: Shard Squad
description: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

name: That's My Exploit Keeper!
description:
Exploit Keeper is a puzzle game, where you have to change the version of the game between the well developed one and the poorly developed one, to find the game bugs and exploit them to be able to continue the plot.
Badly programmed mechanics might be useful if used in the right place...

Between features that work poorly, repeating events and unindexed values, you will find every kind of nightmarish bug for beta testers!

name: Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite
description: The latest in the “Red Spider” series of Hong Kong noir visual novel with full japanese voice acting, “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite” is now available with all-new graphics. The hard-boiled story of two female protagonists is set in Thailand in 2009. Play time: 2-4 hours

name: Tales of Graces F Remastered: Deluxe Edition
description:
Tales of Graces f Remastered is an action RPG with high-speed battles that allow you to switch between fighting styles to match your play style. The remastered title adds more than 80 DLC packs and items release for the original and features stunning visuals, newly localized scenes available in English for the first time, and notable quality of life enhancements such as auto-save.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Tales of Graces f Remastered
• Battle BGM pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Herb Set

name: Zen Pinball World
description: Zen Pinball World brings you the latest and greatest pinball tables to mobile! Dive into the next evolution of pinball mastery from Zen Studios, inspired by the biggest entertainment brands.

name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
description: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

name: Spyro: Enter the Dragonfly - Definitive Edition
description: This mod fixes hundreds upon hundreds of bugs, restores many pieces of unused and even cut content, and adds key quality-of-life improvements to make the experience better than ever.

name: As Dusk Falls: Special Edition
description:
As Dusk Falls is an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT that explores the entangled lives of two families across thirty years.
Special Edition includes: Game, Cinematic Poster, Collector's Box, Dante's Black Book, Postcards, Pins and Desert Dream Motel Replica Key.

name: Enotria: The Last Song - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Enotria: The Last Song includes:

ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK EXTRACT

DIGITAL ARTBOOK EXTRACT

EXCLUSIVE WEAPON SKINS SET

UPGRADE WEAPON MATERIALS

UPGRADE MASK MATERIALS

UPGRADE LINES MATERIALS

EXTRA MIRACLE PESTO

EXTRA HYMN OF VIGOR

EXTRA ARMONIA SAP

name: The Headliners
description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 4 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

name: Eyes That Hypnotise
description: A cozy, hand-drawn puzzle where you arrange fluffy friends to fit the grid. With their funny big eyes and a calming mood, this game offers a relaxing escape.

name: The Talos Principle: Reawakened
description: Step back into a world of thought-provoking puzzles, philosophical intrigue, and breathtaking visuals with The Talos Principle: Reawakened - a first-person puzzle masterpiece for both new players and long-time fans alike.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Glitch Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Glitch Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Vaporwave-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

name: Super Platform Tag
description: Tag, chase, and outsmart your friends in this chaotic platformer party game featuring your favorite variations of tag. Snag crazy power-ups, place obstacles to gain a winning edge, and unlock a colorful cast of characters and stages. Enjoy the ignorant bliss of childhood.

name: A Game About Digging A Hole
description: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

name: Ninja Gaiden: Ragebound
description: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

name: Elden Ring Nightreign
description: Elden Ring: Nightreign is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.

name: Split Fiction
description: Split Fiction is a 2025 cooperative multiplayer game. It follows two writers, Mio Hudson and Zoe Foster, as they become trapped in their imaginations.

name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

name: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
description:
Enter the world of the HBO hit series, Game of Thrones.
Experience an open-world action RPG with an original story found only in Game of Thrones: Kingsroad!

name: Dispatch
description: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

name: Escape Simulator 2
description: Sequel to the best-selling escape room game, brings a fresh take on first-person puzzles with a variety of new rooms to explore solo or with friends. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, or craft your own escape rooms with Room Editor 2.0.

name: The Noexistencen of You and Me
description: Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

name: Agatha Christie: Death on the Nile
description: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into a journey filled with intrigue, deception, and unexpected revelations.

name: Flash Doll
description: Surprise blind boxes and custom outfits combined with physics-driven action figures, automatic battles, custom moves, and intense showdowns ready to start!

name: Hideko
description:
Hideko is a short mystery game about nature.

Explore the rules of a small sandbox world to create new objects, plants and other forms of life! Discover special situations and interactions to earn stars to increase your inventory-size and unlock new areas.

name: Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue
description: Gamestonk is the first roguelite shop simulator. Manage the last videogame store in town, keep up with the latest releases, trade smuggled retros, select your modifiers strategically, hire workers, and deal with pesky shoplifters.*Disclaimer: game titles will crack you up!

name: Ys X: Proud Nordics
description: Stand Proud for a new adventure in Ys X: Proud Nordics! Experience Adol and Karja's unforgettable journey across Obelia Gulf with new quality of life improvements, then discover the new story centering around Öland Island, and the mysterious newcomers Canute and Astrid. And once you're ready, challenge yourself in the devious, time-trial dungeon of Muspelheim, where every second counts. Your new adventure awaits!

name: Off
description: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

name: Meet Santa
description:
Did you ever want to meet Santa? Well, now you can! At least if you can win a match of Nutcracker Run!
Sir Creakwood is ready to take on any opponent—do you have the skill (or luck) to beat him? Roll your way to victory and burn this old wooden creature... for real... please, do it, this thing creeps me out! Who the hell designed these things?!

name: Sackboy: A Big Adventure - Clank Costume
description:
Nobody does The Robot quite like Sackboy. He owns that dance on Craftworld.
So dress him up as Clank, trigger the highly entertaining dance emote and watch him go.
And why not tell your friends to download the Ratchet costume and the Rivet costume too, then you can form your own dream team and head off on thrilling intergalactic adventures!

name: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective
description: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is a charity-fundraising picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by global news stories from throughout the year.

name: Dekiai Heart Candy Kun.
description: This is the otome game that you can experience living together with a slightly twisted boyfriend.

name: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 2 - Future Saga: Chapter 2
description: The second chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history! Includes new Playable Characters, new Extra Missions, Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, and Costumes!

name: Look Outside
description:
Explore the warped interior of the apartment building you are stuck in. Fight hideous monsters that were once your neighbors. Manage weapons and ammo. Play video games. Craft bombs from household supplies. Cook. Answer the door. DONT let them in. Keep yourself alive and sane as the world just outside your window stops making sense.

Just whatever you do...
DONT LOOK OUTSIDE

A survival horror RPG by Francis Coulombe, with music by Eric Shumaker, made in one month for the Hawktober game jam.

name: Code Violet
description:
Developed by TeamKill Media, Code Violet is a third-person action horror game, where you take on the role of Violet Sinclair, a girl plucked from the past who must unravel the mysteries of the Aion Bioengineering Complex as she avoids, hides or fights against the creatures who have overrun it.

With the evacuation protocol in effect, Violet’s main goal is to escape the complex and save those she cares for, but with the creatures and a mysterious Director doing all in their power to stop you, will you get out alive?

name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Hero of Justice Pack
description:
DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO HERO OF JUSTICE Pack contains the following contents from the Dragon Ball SUPER: SUPER HERO movie.

- 11 Playable Characters:
• Gohan, Superhero
• Gohan, Superhero Super Saiyan
• Ultimate Gohan, Superhero
• Gohan Beast
• Piccolo, Superhero
• Piccolo, Potential Unleashed
• Orange Piccolo
• Orange Piccolo, Giant Form
• Gamma 1
• Gamma 2
• Cell Max

- New Costume:
• Piccolo, Superhero
This is the costume Piccolo wears when infiltrating the Red Ribbon Army base in Dragon Ball SUPER: SUPER HERO.

- 3 Bonus Battles

Experience the intense battles from the Dragon Ball SUPER: SUPER HERO movie in custom battles, including the fierce fight between Piccolo and Gamma 2, the epic showdown between Gohan and Gamma 1, and the thrilling battle where Gohan and Piccolo face off against Cell Max.

name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Dragon Ball Daima: Character Pack 1
description:
New warriors from the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series join the battle!

- 8 Playable Characters:
• Goku (Mini), Super Saiyan
• Vegeta (Mini)
• Vegeta (Mini), Super Saiyan
• Vegeta (Mini), Super Saiyan 2
• Vegeta (Mini), Super Saiyan 3
• Glorio
• Panzy
• Majin Kuu

‐ Goku (Mini) Technique-changing Outfit
• New costume for Goku (Mini) that changes his moves

Get the Dragon Ball DAIMA: Character Pack 1 and enjoy new battles!

*Goku (Mini) Technique-changing Outfit is different from Pre-Order Pack Goku (Mini).
*Ownership of Pre-Order Pack Goku (Mini) is not required.
*Equipping the Goku (Mini) Technique-changing Outfit costume on Goku (Mini) will not alter his appearance.
*Equipping the Goku (Mini) Technique-changing Outfit costume on Goku (Mini) will transform his Ultimate Blast into Aura Impact.

name: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Dragon Ball Daima: Character Pack 2
description:
New warriors from the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series join the battle!

- 6 Playable Characters:
• Goku (Mini), Super Saiyan 4
• Goku (DAIMA), Super Saiyan 4
• Vegeta (DAIMA), Super Saiyan 3
• Majin Duu
• Third Eye Gomah
• Giant Gomah

Get the Dragon Ball DAIMA: Character Pack 2 and enjoy new battles!

name: Death Howl
description: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world in a soulslike deck builder. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

name: Schedule I
description: Schedule I is a first-person open-world crime simulation game where players build and manage a drug trafficking operation in the fictional city of Hyland Point. Gameplay combines business management with tactical strategy, as players grow and manufacture various substances, sell to residents while avoiding police, and expand through hiring employees and purchasing properties. Drugs can be mixed with various ingredients to alter their effects and increase sell value. Players must contend with law enforcement mechanics including random searches, roadblocks, and a wanted system. The game also features an active modding community and cooperative multiplayer.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Claus Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Claus Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Christimas-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

name: Turning the Page
description:
For Felix and Sophie Page, two professors at Riverside College, things are going very well. They have jobs they love, they are well respected and most importantly: they have each other. In fact, their recent marriage has made it official. Nothing could get between them... except maybe one of their students...

Turning the Page is a Visual Novel focused on Netorare and Corruption.

In particular, it is part of the “mystery NTR” subgenre, meaning that the player can choose to experience the story through either the hero’s point of view, with an obscured and limited view of what is happening, or from the heroine’s perspective which shows her being stolen away from the hero in complete detail.

name: Bowser's Diary: Take the Quiz!
description: Bowser's Diary Quiz was an HTML game available from the official Paper Mario website. There were six different files for this quiz, labeled "quiz_1.html" all the way to "quiz_6.html".

name: Chrono Gear: Warden of Time
description: Turn back the clock and fight to repair Time itself in this cinematic action platformer with fast sword combat and time-based powers. You are the Warden of Time, Ouro Kronii - be proud and fight hard!

name: New Meat
description: New Meat is a fast-paced horror-comedy roguelite about burgers, monsters and dead-end jobs.

name: Ninja Gaiden 4
description: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with Ninja Gaiden 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

name: Ninja Gaiden II Black
description: Using Unreal Engine 5 to significantly enhance graphic expression, this is the definitive version of "NINJA GAIDEN 2," featuring additional playable characters and enhanced battle support functions.

name: Tales of Hearts R: Infinite Evolve
description: Included in the first print copies (pre-order) of Tales of Hearts R on the Vita and available with a digital release for a limited time. It's a minigame rendered in the same graphic style as Tales of Hearts – the DS version, it is a game separate from the main story with an exponentially increasing difficulty level. Yuri, Jade, Stan, and Lloyd show up as guest characters and comes with special skits.

name: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit
description: The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in 8-bits! Battle through frantic platforming levels, defeat classic AVGN bosses, and save all of gaming from a corrupted monstrosity.

name: Escape from Duckov
description: A single-player top-down looter-shooter game. Loot, escape, build, and eventually become a mighty bird soldier. Beware! If you are knocked down, items in your inventory will be lost! But don't worry. With your infrastructure built nicely, you will rise again soon.

name: Walk Zero1
description: The distant future... There are almost no people left on planet Earth, everyone has moved to Mars. The age of prosperity, the age of robots, androids, technology. And then one day, robot Zero1 decided to take a walk around planet Earth. What awaits him? Desert? Vast forests? Who will he meet on his way? All this is to be found out in the walking simulator.

name: Cubic Odyssey
description: Embark on a galactic journey in Cubic Odyssey, an open-world adventure where you explore vibrant planets, craft tools, build vehicles, and fight the Red Darkness. Uncover ancient mysteries, and shape a universe full of life, danger, and limitless possibilities!

name: Dragon Ball Sparking Zero: Pre-order Pack
description:
The Pre-Order Pack includes the following content for DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO:
- Exclusive new playable character:
• Goku (Mini)
- Early unlock of the following six characters:
• Gogeta
• Gogeta, Super Saiyan
• Gogeta, Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
• Broly
• Broly, Super Saiyan
• Broly, Super Saiyan (Full Power)

*Goku (Mini) voice over language is Japanese only.

name: Is This Seat Taken?
description: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

name: Shelldom
description: In Shelldom, snails worship alcohol—a drink they love but one that kills them. Their cults sacrifice their own for more, trapped in a doomed cycle. But legend speaks of the Holy Water, hidden atop a merciless tower. Can you climb, endure, and break the curse? Or will you fall like the rest?

name: Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny
description: Reclaim your destiny. Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny returns with higher resolution graphics and modernised controls to perform issen critical counter attacks and intense swordplay. Experience this dramatic revenge story set in Feudal Japan.

name: Easy Delivery Co.
description: Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.

name: Static Dread: The Lighthouse
description: Lovecraft meets Papers, Please. Play as a lighthouse keeper and guide ships safely into the harbor using your radio. Survive the presence of something impossible, and don’t let the shadows consume you!

name: Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion
description:
Plants Vs. Zombies: Fusion is a Plants Vs. Zombies fangame developed mainly by Blue Fly using the Unity engine.

The main concept of the game involves fusing your plants to make them stronger.

name: Bishoujo Super Street Fighter II: Glamor Queen
description: Bishoujo Super Street Fighter II: Glamor Queen is a combo ROM Hack of the Sega Mega Drive version of Super Street Fighter II, where some of the characters are replaced with characters from various franchises. It draws some inspiration from several bootleg versions of Champion Edition, as well as other Street Fighter II ROM Hacks such as Street Fighter II: Mix and Super Street Fighter II Turbo: New Legacy.

name: Jerkmate: Ranked
description:
Rejoice: Jerkmate Ranked is real! All the hilarious user-generated content has inspired Jerky to make one more fantasy come true. Play the Jerkmate Ranked game to reach the highest ranks of fapping mastery. Will you be the next Grandmaster Baiter, or should you bear the Bronze Beater title forever? Your destiny (and hopefully something else) is now in your hands!

Jerkmate Ranked is more than an Internet trend. It’s a statement for all jerkers, fappers, wankers, gooners, edgers and meat beaters worldwide. United, we stand firm! Let’s honor Jerky, our universal symbol of sexual freedom, inclusiveness and diversity. Flaunt your Jerkmate rank like an honor badge because it is. Good luck, and may the nuts be with you.

name: Elden Ring Nightreign: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition Includes:
• ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
• Additional DLC
- Additional playable characters and bosses
• Digital Artbook & Mini Soundtrack

name: Elden Ring Nightreign: Collector's Edition
description:
Collector's Edition Includes:

ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN Base Game (Physical disc for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, physical STEAM voucher for STEAM) - ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.
Additional DLC* – Additional DLC that will be available after the release of the main game
Statue of Wylder - A perfect replica of the nomadic warrior, Wylder, a lone swordman in pursuit of the Night Lord. Crafted by Pure Arts. Size : 25cm
SteelBook - Premium metal case with a full-color illustration of Wylder. The perfect protection and display for your game disc
Nightfarer Cards - A set of eight high-quality tarot cards featuring detailed illustrations of the Nightfarers. These glossy, full color cards are the perfect way to predict your future in Limveld
Exclusive Hardcover Artbook - An exclusive 40-page artbook tracing the development of ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN through previously unseen concept art, sketches, and full color illustrations. Size: 24 x 21 cm Language: English
Digital Soundtrack Download Code - The unforgettable original soundtrack is included in this Collector’s Edition. Return to Limveld again and again with fully orchestrated tracks from ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN.
Collector’s Box - A beautiful case to store or display your statue and artbook.

name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger
description: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

name: Warriors: Abyss
description:
Take command of historic and masterful warriors by challenging countless swarms of enemies. Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.

A new type of battles fought alongside combinations of 100 and more heroes.
There are 100 and more heroes for players to ally with, allowing them to combine the unique traits of multiple heroes and create their own powerful parties who will help them fight their way through the dead souls of Hell.

A new form of "Warriors" where heroes can be summoned to help eliminate enemies.
By summoning heroes, the player can engage in impressive battles where they daringly rout endless hordes of enemies. This feature will offer players a new form of exhilaration never before experienced in the "Warriors" series.

name: Lies of P: Overture
description: Lies of P: Overture is a story expansion for Lies of P that introduces new narrative developments, environments, enemies, and weapons. It builds on the core game's mechanics while expanding the dark reimagining of the Pinocchio tale with additional challenges and lore.

name: Metal Eden
description:
An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS.
A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

name: Saros
description: Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

name: The Daruma Challenge
description: A brutal bouncing challenge. No shortcuts, no mercy—just you vs. gravity. How far will you climb before it all comes crashing down?

name: Astro Bot: Vicious Void
description:
This free update features harder levels to test your jumping skills. Each level comes with a brand-new Special Bot to rescue and, once that’s done, can be replayed in Time Attack mode with online rankings. It has weekly release schedule:

- Feb 13: Tick-Tock Shock
- Feb 20: Thrust or Bust
- Feb 27: Cock-A-Doodle-Doom
- Mar 6: Hard to Bear
- Mar 13: Armored Hardcore

name: Death Kid
description: Death Kid is a fast-paced arcade-inspired arena brawler with meta-progression. Wipe out hordes of daunting foes, master powerful abilities and grow stronger with each attempt. Venture deep inside a treacherous well to put the wheel of life and death back in motion and break the curse of immortality.

name: Monster Train 2
description: It's time to raise Hell in Heaven! Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

name: Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil
description:
Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil (commonly abbreviated to as RoE) is an expansion pack for Doom 3 developed by Nerve Software and id Software included on BFG Edition that features enhanced graphics, better audio with more horror effects, a checkpoint save system, and support for 3D displays and HMDs.

The expansion pack included several new monsters, as well as three new weapons.

name: Bumer: Sorvannye bashni
description:
Bumer: Sorvannye bashni is an arcade first-person shooter with racing elements. It is based on the Russian movie Bumer, but as a free interpretation. The gameplay consists of racing, gang chases and gunfights. Racing levels are similar to sprint races from the Need for Speed series. The player races point-to-point tracks and needs to finish before an opponent.

Chases in Bumer consist of racing and shooting elements. AI-controlled passengers of the character's car kill enemies to defend the car. For every killed enemy the player receives new weapons. These include assault rifles - AK-47 and AKSU, Makarov and Tokarev pistols, double-barreled and sawed-off shotguns, grenades. Temporary bonuses are also provided, such as invisibility, health regeneration, faster speed, slow motion, full ammunition, radioactivity and others.

The gameplay of the last two levels is pure first-person shooting: you kill enemies, take the bonuses and weapons for every killed enemy and complete objectives such as placing the bomb, killing a boss, and defending against enemies.

An additional game mode called 'Sorvannye bashni' is a survival level where you need to defend against waves of enemies.

name: R.E.P.O.
description: R.E.P.O. (Retrieve, Extract and Profit Operation) is an online cooperative survival horror game for up to six players, developed by Swedish studio Semiwork using the Unity engine. Players are tasked with locating valuable physics-based objects within procedurally generated environments and carefully transporting them to extraction points without damaging them, all while avoiding hostile creatures. Between levels, players spend earned currency on permanent upgrades, weapons, and tools at a service station. The game emphasizes verbal coordination and strategic planning among teammates.

name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Deluxe Edition
description:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a ground-breaking turn-based RPG with unique real-time mechanics, making battles more immersive and addictive than ever. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France in which you battle devastating enemies.

Get the ultimate Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 experience with the Deluxe Edition!
The Deluxe Edition includes:

·Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Base Game
·The “Flowers” Collection - Six outfits and hairstyles inspired by the Flowers of Lumière, along with six additional “Gommage” outfit variations. One for each playable character.
·“Clair” - A custom outfit for Maelle
·“Obscur” - A custom outfit for Gustave

name: Wrap House Simulator
description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

name: Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake
description: Guide Timmy the little treasure hunter through traps and puzzles to reach the legendary treasure. This classic mini metroidvania is remade with new visuals, music, and content.

name: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Part 1
description: Part 1 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

name: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Part 2
description: Part 2 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

name: Overcome Your Fears: Caretaker
description: Overcome Your Fears - is a psychological atmospheric horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown.

name: Decks of Dexterity
description: Decks of Dexterity fuses bullet hell shooter gameplay with a strategic turn based card game; your deck determines your power! Explore the Void to discover hundreds of cards, powerful treasures, unique characters, all contributes to building a powerful deck and defeating the corruption!

name: Cookie Cutter: Overkill Edition
description:
Cookie Cutter is a gorgeous hand-drawn techno-pop-punk post-kawaii Metroidvania. Play as the heroine Cherry on a quest for revenge as you run, jump, explore, and fight your way through a beautifully blood-soaked world.

Overkill Edition features All new voice work! Brand new attacks and cut scenes, updated map features and tons of gameplay tweaks!

name: Wednesdays
description: "The hardest part is not to speak up. It’s being heard." Part video game, part graphic novel, Wednesdays seeks to raise awareness about child sexual abuse through a surprisingly uplifting story.

name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes Monster Hunter Wilds (main game) and the Monster Hunter Wilds Deluxe Pack!

name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Premium Deluxe Edition
description: The Premium Deluxe Edition includes Monster Hunter Wilds (main game), and the Monster Hunter Wilds Cosmetic DLC Pass, which consists of 3 DLC packs including the Deluxe Pack at a great value!

name: Absolum
description: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

name: Veins of Darkness
description: Veins of Darkness is a first-person horror game. The hero is an ordinary shift worker. During a business trip, his company rented him a house on the outskirts. But no one knew what evil was hiding in this godforsaken place.

name: Spear
description: A fast-paced action-platformer where an NPC wields a makeshift spear to fight glitches, solve puzzles, and save his own game.

name: New Kids Nitro Racer
description:
"New Kids Nitro Racer" is a racing game based on the Dutch movie "New Kids Nitro".

The game's levels are based on Maaskantje, the Dutch Village the New Kids series is based on, and the Dutch A2 motorway.

name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
description: RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!

name: Deserto Divino
description: You're Quespin, a young Egyptian who suddenly dreams of something that could change your life forever — so you set off on a bold journey across Egypt’s endless deserts and ancient pyramids to chase it. Along the way, you'll face challenges, meet unforgettable people, and discover that this journey will transform your life in ways you never imagined.

name: Forefront
description: Forefront is an intense VR shooter featuring 32-player large-scale battles, land, sea, and air vehicles, and immersive, tactical combat. You are the tip of the spear in the war between a global energy giant and resistance forces. Which side will you take?

name: Ghost Town
description: Ghost Town is a single player VR puzzle-adventure from the makers of The Room. London, 1983. Edith Penrose is a ghost hunter, busy exorcising her way through the city's restless spirits. But after her brother goes missing Edith must draw upon her wits & supernatural talents to unravel the mystery.

name: PowerWash Simulator 2
description: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

name: Dice a Million
description: Have you ever tried rolling 1,000,000 points on some dice? No? Well, now at least you can try.

name: Brush Burial: Gutter World
description: A murky first-person immersive sim with tightly-wound melee combat and tangled, vertical levels to explore. Use your forked tail to tie your enemies in knots and climb impossible heights. Kill your mark with quickness and cunning, using whatever tools you see fit.

name: Demon's Souls: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Demon’s Souls Digital Deluxe Edition includes the full game and additional in game digital content to prepare you for the ultimate challenge, including;

• Legendary Hero Soul
• Renowned Warrior Soul
• Storied Warrior Soul
• Red-Eye Knight Armor
• Boletarian Royalty Armor
• Ritual Blade
• Hoplite Shield
• Ring of Longevity
• Preservation Grains
• Phosphorescent Grains
• Bearbug Grains
• Large Hardstone Shard
• Moonlightstone Shard
• Original soundtrack

name: Raidou Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
description: The story of apprentice detective and Devil Summoner extraordinaire Raidou Kuzunoha XIV returns in this remastered classic! Call upon your demons to solve supernatural mysteries and dispose of enemies.

name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
description: Create Mii characters based on family and friends, someone you admire, or something completely original—there are plenty of personality traits, little quirks, and physical traits to choose from—including some face customization options you haven’t seen before! Go deep into getting every detail just right, or create Miis quickly and easily by answering some simple questions, and then help them explore their likes and dislikes, find relationships, and get up to all sorts of fun. Your Miis are bound to surprise you as they take on a life of their own!

name: Midnight Shift
description: One girl worked at a gas station in Wisconsin, and during one of her midnight shifts, the most unexpected thing happened to her.

name: Shadow of Light
description:
Shadow of Light is a 1-bit platformer with stealth mechanics.
You will get new abilities, that will help you in your way, such as dash, double jump and wall jump.

name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
description: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns with Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, launching on July 9, 2026. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

name: Dreams of Aether
description: A collection of dozens of Aether-flavored microgames! Dive into the Dreams of Aether, where everyone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare! Meet some of the strangest characters Aether has to offer!

name: Mario Kart World
description: Mario Kart World is a kart racing game for the Nintendo Switch 2, featuring characters from the Mario franchise.
