It introduces an open-world design to the series, allowing players to drive freely between courses rather than selecting them from a menu. Races support up to 24 players and include new mechanics such as off-roading, boat racing, rail grinding, and wall riding. The game features a Knockout Tour elimination mode where racers compete across connected courses with periodic eliminations at checkpoints, as well as a Free Roam mode for open exploration and collectible-finding.

name: Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour
description: Enter a virtual exhibition and gain insights into what makes Nintendo Switch 2 such a unique gaming experience. Through tech demos, minigames and other interactions, players will get to know the new system inside and out in ways they may never have known about otherwise.

name: Yakuza 0: Director's Cut
description:
Yakuza 0: Director's Cut is the definitive edition of the critically acclaimed prequel to the Yakuza series.

Director's Cut content gives deeper insight into key incidents and character backstories with never-before-seen cutscenes and enhanced features like English and Chinese voiceovers, and multi-language text support. Plus, the Red Light Raid online multiplayer mode lets you join forces with friends and choose from 60 playable characters to take down hordes of enemies.

name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
description:
Fight the war for ancient Hyrule! Step on to the battlefield as Princess Zelda, King Rauru, and other legendary heroes as you fight to reclaim your homeland— and live the story of Demon King Ganondorf's invasion that was only briefly alluded to in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom game.

Princess Zelda is not alone in this war! Join Mineru, the Sages, and even some brand-new heroes in battles against Ganondorf's forces. Combine powerful Zonai Devices with your heroes' signature abilities to take down powerful bosses and their legions of minions.

name: Donkey Kong Bananza
description: Donkey Kong Bananza is exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2! Explore a vast underground world—by smashing your way through it! Bash, throw, and climb through just about anything in DK’s brand-new 3D platforming action-adventure game!

name: Super Mariomon
description: Super Mariomon is a passionate community-driven project that blends the iconic charm of Super Mario with the strategic gameplay of Pokémon. Experience familiar faces like Mario, Luigi, Bowser, and more, now as unique and collectible Mariomon. Battle your way through reimagined regions, challenge familiar foes, and become the ultimate Mariomon Master

name: The Dark Rites of Arkham
description: A macabre ritual murder puts Arkham PD detectives Jack Foster and Harvey Whitman to the test. As the investigation progresses, they will unveil a disturbing connection between the Salem witch trials of the 17th century and the end of humankind.

name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 1
description: The first Title Update for Monster Hunter Wilds features the return of Mizutsune, Arch-Tempered Rey Dau, The Grand Hub, and a new Zoh Shia quest with craftable gear.

name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 2
description: The second Title Update for Monster Hunter Wilds features the return of Lagiacrus and Seregios, Arch-Tempered Uth Duna, layered weapons, and the Festival of Accord: Flamefete event.

name: Nomia
description:
Nomia is a story-rich tactics roguelike where two heroes coordinate to execute brilliant skill combos.

Guide a warrior and a wizard through a mystifying tale. Harness grid-based strategy and deep deckbuilding mechanics to battle gorgeously illustrated foes. Blast monsters off cliffs, steal their cards, and sling spear and spell to reach the horizon.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Keep on the Borderlands
description: Help the commonfolk trapped within the Keep on the Borderlands in their struggle against the Cult of Evil Chaos. A collection of 8 quest dungeons adapted from the classic D&D module for new characters & early epic levels. The Borderlands is also a large adventure area where players can hunt monsters and obtain horses.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Seal of Shan-to-Kor
description: A premium three-part dungeon for low level characters. Search the sewers for a large hobgoblin town and take back the Seal of Shan-To-Kor before its power is turned against Stormreach.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Sharn Syndicate
description: A small series of very short premium dungeons for low level characters. Protect the marketplace from a gang that extorts innocent business owners.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Delera's Tomb
description: A premium collection of short dungeons about ghostly skeletons and other undead. The main quests are narrated by Gary Gygax.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Lost Gatekeepers
description: A small series of short premium dungeons for low level characters. The Gatekeepers have established a new grove outside Stormreach and some of the recently recruited initiates have gone missing. Follow the clues to help rescue these would-be guardians of Eberron.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Devil Assault
description: The Chronoscope premium raid and a dungeon that supports multiple character levels. Travel back in time to find out what happened when a vortex of invading devils destroyed the Stormreach Marketplace.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Vault of Night
description: A premium six-part quest series, culminating in an epic raid battle against a red dragon. The story revolves around recruiting the lost Laughing Knives companions to help infiltrate a heavily fortified vault. This was the first raid added to Dungeons & Dragons Online.

name: Star Wars Zero Company
description: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company, a single-player turn-based tactics game.

name: The Last of Us Complete
description:
Go back to the beginning and experience the award-winning games that inspired the TV show, as the definitive editions of these two iconic titles are brought together for the first time in one complete collection.

Bundle includes:
• The Last of Us Part I
• The Last of Us Part II Remastered

name: Uncanny Tales: Cold Road
description: Uncanny Tales is an episodic horror series where the real terror comes not from monsters or the supernatural, but from people. Each episode is a new unsettling story inspired by real fears and eerie situations from everyday life.

name: Heartopia
description: Heartopia is a life simulator which gives gamers the chance to slow down and enjoy the little moments in life! No matter your hobbies, personality, talents, or appearance, Heartopia is your chance to share them with the world -- however you want.

name: Rusted
description: Rusted is a Linear horror game. You wake up after coma, but something isn't right. Everything is worn down and there's rust everywhere. How long have you been out for? Figure out what happen and find your way out. But be careful, you're not alone.

name: Catch Pokémon
description: A game on Google Search in which the player collects Pokémon by searching for their names. A hint about a random Pokémon is also given, and Master Balls are unlocked under certain conditions for the Legendaries and Mythical ones. Only the first generation of Pokémon is available (the first 151).

name: Five Nights at Frickbear's 3
description:
Five Nights at Frickbear's 3 is a FNaF fangame with a big focus on player choice and replayability, featuring a uniquely goofy art style, a metric buttload of unique animatronic enemies, 3D free-roam minigames, and multiple story routes!

Can YOU survive Five Nights at Frickbear's? ...3?

name: Femboy Futa House
description: Congratulations, you've been accepted to the College of Magical Arts! Immerse yourself in a rich student life full of magic, passion, and adventure. Meet the eccentric residents of dorm 9 ¾ and get to know them as closely as you can...

name: Resident Evil Remake Trilogy
description:
This great value pack contains three Resident Evil remake titles and additional content.

- RESIDENT EVIL 2 Deluxe Edition PS4 & PS5
- RESIDENT EVIL 3 PS4 & PS5
- RESIDENT EVIL 3 - Classic Costume Pack PS4 & PS5
- Resident Evil Resistance PS4
- Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition PS4 & PS5
- Resident Evil 4 - The Mercenaries PS4 & PS5

name: Amanda the Adventurer 3
description: In the thrilling conclusion of the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy, follow Riley as they uncover the ultimate secrets behind Amanda, Hameln, and mysteries that have plagued Kensdale for decades.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Vaults of the Artificers
description: From fiery crystal mines and kobold-infested islands to fantastic extra-planar vaults, House Cannith needs you for missions of acquisition and conquest. This is a premium collection of dungeons with 12 timed challenges. They support all character levels and play more like very long minigames that reward teamwork.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Temple of Elemental Evil
description: An enormous premium dungeon narrated by Wil Wheaton. Adapted from the classic Dungeons & Dragons pen-and-paper module.

name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Attack on Stormreach
description: A premium set of 4 quest dungeons. Droaam, the kingdom of monsters, is attacking Stormreach. These adventures bring players over, under and around Stormreach, eventually leading to an ancient giant's ruin where monstrous deeds are underway.

name: Doki Doki Salvation Remake!
description:
This is a remake of the mod Doki Doki Salvation that came out in 2018.

What if things could be different? What if you could save her? This question plagued the minds of most people after finishing the first act of DDLC. The story begins shortly after MC confesses his love for Sayori on the day before the festival. something wakes him up in the middle of the night however, and prompts him to check on Sayori, stopping her before she takes her own life. Salvation Remake is a mod that lets you see what a second chance could've looked like. A chance that, in some cases, we don't get to have. The mod, while being Sayori focused, also gives the others, especially Monika, a chance to show their own stories as they all struggle to cope with the near loss of a beloved friend. The mod puts a much heavier emphasis on friendship and trust rather than romance, and offers a much more grounded experience than the original does. Would you be her salvation once more?

name: Horripilant
description: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon.

name: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
description: The incredible Mr. Rabbit invites you all to a mysterious magic show! Celebrate 10 years of Rusty Lake with a new free-to-play point-and-click adventure that promises to delight and… shock you with its sleight of hand!

name: Dodo Duckie
description: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises

name: Gears of War: Reloaded
description: The original Gears of War returns, faithfully remastered and natively optimized for more platforms than ever before as Gears of War: Reloaded. Experience the origins of one of gaming’s most acclaimed franchises like never before. Featuring 4K resolution, up to 120 FPS support, and the ultimate multiplayer experience with cross-progression and cross-play, across all platforms, this is the definitive way to experience the game that started it all.

name: Moldwasher
description: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

name: Gamblers Table
description:
Gamblers Table is an idle automation game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying.

Click a coin to toss it. Every time it lands on Heads, you earn money.

The more coins you own, the more you can flip. Buy upgrades to make them flip faster and yield more money. Discover curious interactions and unexpected synergies between different coin types.

Hire little helpers to take care of all the manual labour for you. They don’t complain, and they never question.

Leave your fortune behind and rise to something greater. Start again with peculiar new talents you didn’t have before.

Admire your riches, lean back, and watch your automated coin-flipping empire grow.

name: Pigface
description: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.

name: A day with Marco
description: A sound engineer's daily adventure in court. Help Marco juggle sullen judges, quirky colleagues and bosses always on his heels.

name: Breakout Epilepsia
description: A fast-paced Breakout-style arcade with a bold black-and-white aesthetic. Engage in space battles against stunning yet deadly alien foes who are determined to destroy you. Intense visuals, thrilling gameplay, and a challenge that will test your reflexes.

name: Depth Complaint
description:
Depth Complaint (The Unfinished RPG) is a game created by Zero Dollar Gift Card AKA ZeDoGiCa/ZeDo, in RPGMaker VX Ace.

You play as ADAM, a slime, who throughout the game will meet and absorb other party members into himself.
Its visuals are comprised almost entirely out of rough sketches and found images, arranged in surreal collages, and its soundtrack is an eclectic mix of experimental music, hip-hop, jazz, and vaporwave, all laden with samples.

The game was made with the intention of being abandoned partly through its own development, and much of the dialogue reflects this. It explores themes of artist's block, creative struggle, and self-doubt.

The estimated playtime is 0.5-2 hours.

name: Baionlenja
description: Baionlenja is a first-person metroidvania with an extreme movement focus. Explore the vast and interconnected research facility, where a mysterious fossil grants you unimaginable power and mobility. B-hop, rocket jump and air strafe to uncover the secrets of the Baionlenja corporation.

name: Sticky Business: Book of Shadows
description: Add a little magic to your sticker shop with the Book of Shadows DLC! Craft enchanted stickers, explore witchy new stories, and charm your customers with mystical goodies in this cozy, spellbinding expansion. The coven is waiting!

name: Terrors to Unveil: Intrusion
description: David Hopster, a 15-year-old high school student, has just been left home alone for the weekend while his parents head out of town. At first, everything seemed normal. He had no idea how quickly things would spiral.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
description: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine returns. Enhanced for a new generation! Enjoy quality of life & graphical improvements that take the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine experience to the next level.

name: The Daily Life of Serving Doll
description: Start a sweet life with the breast-expanding robot [Service Doll Aisha] who was born to serve you！This is the sequel to “Escape from the Room of the Serving Doll”！Uses the same 3D animation for the H scene as its predecessor， and you can't miss the soft and textured breast animation！

name: Hozy
description: Transform abandoned spaces into cozy havens in Hozy!

name: Dark Quest 4
description: A turn based dungeon crawler where you create a party of heroes to go on epic quests.

name: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
description: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

name: The Trolley Solution
description: The Trolley Solution is a compilation of point-and-click minigames based on the famous thought experiment originally proposed by Philippa Foot.

name: Ball x Pit
description: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite where you battle hordes of monstrous enemies with your arsenal of ricocheting balls.

name: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
description: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

name: Retro Rewind: Video Store Simulator
description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

name: A Day's Work
description: Explore, harvest resources, catch pet rabbits, and help friendly characters as you uncover secrets in this small, wholesome, single-player adventure.

name: Digger: Galactic Treasures
description: Digger: Galactic Treasures is a space adventure where you drill into asteroids to uncover rare resources and hidden treasures. Explore the galaxy, upgrade your gear, and discover the secrets of the universe!

name: Deep Space Exploitation
description: Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics, fully destructible asteroids, and a story of survival under an exploitative corporation. Use your equipment wisely, upgrade your ship, and make difficult decisions to secure your future!

name: Qubicks
description: Qubicks is where tower defense meets roguelike as you venture across procedurally generated levels where you strategically position towers, balancing immediate survival with long-term growth. Upgrade your towers and heroes to adapt to difficult waves and ensure victory against alien inhabitants.

name: Romeo is a Dead Man
description:
Latest ultra-violent sci-fi action title from Grasshopper Manufacture and Suda51.

Step into the blood-soaked boots of Romeo Stargazer, a man pulled back from the brink of death by a time paradox gone wrong. Now reborn as Agent Dead Man of the FBI Space-Time Division, and armed with the mysterious Dead Gear mask, Romeo must chase the universe’s most dangerous fugitives across alternate realities.

Blending high-octane gunplay, brutal sword combat, and over-the-top sci-fi insanity, Romeo Is a Dead Man is GhM’s bloodiest action game yet. Players can expect mind-bending twists, outrageous gimmicks, and a deeply cathartic combat system that turns enemies’ powers against them in universe-shattering battles.

As Romeo tears through the multiverse, he’s also on a desperate quest to find Juliet, his mysteriously vanished girlfriend. With a narrative that fuses love, loss, and metaphysical chaos, Romeo Is a Dead Man offers a stylish and unpredictable journey through the very fabric of time itself.

Can you survive the bleeding edge of space-time? Or will you become just another ghost in the paradox?

name: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles
description: This dramatic tale of ambition, betrayal, and honor comes to life again with an updated and enriched script with fully voiced dialogue, alongside improved graphics that bring a new level of immersion and playability to the battlefield. Additionally, the enhanced version brings quality-of-life updates like new difficulties, a revamped UI, auto save, and more that make the game more accessible to newcomers.

name: Nioh 3
description: In the latest game in the dark samurai action RPG series "Nioh," you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open world.

name: Hissy Fit: Make Snake Break
description: MAKE chaotic maps, SNAKE through them and BREAK everything in sight - including leader board records! Hissy Fit is a whimsical sandbox for all ages that encourages creativity, endless experimentation and discovery.

name: Find My Frogs
description: Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game full of frogs, mushrooms and moss. Help Uncle Froger take a commemorative photo, or just lounge in the pond and relax.

name: Fairground Online
description: Fairground Online - The ultimate simulator! Control rides, create light shows and accompany them with music. Experience realistic physics, detailed controls and the day-night cycle. Play online with friends worldwide and become part of the community!

name: Mortal Shell II
description: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

name: Code Vein II
description:
Code Vein II is an action role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world where Revenants are being transformed into hostile "Horrors." A Revenant Hunter must partner with a time-manipulating companion named Lou.
Gameplay features third-person action combat and deep RPG progression, emphasizing specialized Blood-based mechanics and character customization. An evolved Partner System enhances tactical cooperation with AI companions during exploration and high-difficulty boss encounters. Success depends on mastering diverse weaponry and temporal abilities to survive a world defined by memory and ruin.

name: Jurassic World Evolution 3
description: Build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

name: Scott Pilgrim EX
description: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!

name: Mongil: Star Dive
description:
Dive into a world of wonder!
A dazzling monster-taming Action RPG!

name: Resident Evil Requiem
description: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

name: Dreamcards
description: Build your deck during the day and at night fight the monster that haunts your dreams. Will you be able to escape the nightmare in this roguelike deckbuilder that combines strategy, occultism and psychology?

name: Anxiety Puppy
description: Anxiety Puppy is a 2D interactive narrative game that focuses on anxiety. In the game, anxiety is personified as a little puppy. Players will explore its story and try to coexist with it. Go find its traces and give it a hug.

name: Call of the Elder Gods
description: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

name: Fallstruktur
description: It takes a while to go back to sleep, but inevitably, you return. To dream of the Fallstruktur.

name: High on Life 2
description: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
description: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

name: Beast of Reincarnation
description: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

name: Aphelion
description: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

name: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf
description: Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui. Whether you're a returning hero or a new adventurer, step into a world where a new, ancient mystery emerges from Novo's hidden depths. But as they scour these depths, a new threat will put their unbreakable bond to the ultimate test, guiding Lana to confront her destiny amidst encroaching shadows.

name: Invincible Vs.
description: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

name: Keeper
description: From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is an atmospheric puzzle adventure in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is a first-person shooter set in 2035, co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software. The game features three main modes: a cooperative campaign playable with up to four players or solo, multiplayer with 6v6 and 20v20 modes, and the round-based Zombies mode. Multiplayer features a perk system split into combat specialties, weapon prestige progression, and scorestreak rewards.

name: Ambrosia Sky
description: You are Dalia, a deep-space disaster specialist dispatched to the rings of Saturn. You’ll lay victims to rest, clean up alien fungus, and research its strange origins. Adapt to survive, cleanse the contamination, and escape the crisis.

name: Citizen Pain
description: Citizen Pain is a first-person dark fantasy action game. Play as Catherina, warrior princess of the Moges Empire, who gains the supernatural force known as Pain and leads the fight against the Undead King. Classic single-player combat meets modern visuals in this skill-based indie experience.

name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
description: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

name: Forza Horizon 6
description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

name: Lies of P: Overture Bundle
description:
Lies of P is a thrilling soulslike that takes the story of Pinocchio, turns it on its head, and sets it against the darkly elegant backdrop of the Belle Epoque.

You are a puppet created by Geppetto who’s caught in a web of lies with unimaginable monsters and untrustworthy figures standing between you and the events that have befallen the world of Lies of P.

You are awakened by a mysterious voice that guides you through the plagued city of Krat - a once lively place that has been poisoned by madness and bloodlust. In our soulslike, you must adapt yourself and your weapons to face untold horrors, untangle the unfathomable secrets of the city’s elites and choose whether to confront predicaments with the truth or weave lies to overcome them on the journey to find yourself.

Confront the people who manipulate the strings of treachery that doomed Krat.

Lies of P: Overture is a dramatic prequel to the acclaimed soulslike action RPG, Lies of P. It transports you to the city of Krat in its final days of haunting, late-19th-century Belle Époque beauty. On the brink of the Puppet Frenzy massacre, you follow a legendary Stalker—a mysterious guide—through untold stories and chilling secrets. As Geppetto’s deadly puppet, you’ll journey through Krat and its surroundings, uncover hidden backstories, and face epic battles that shape the past and future of Lies of P.

As Geppetto’s Puppet, you encounter a mysterious artifact that transports you back to Krat in its final days of grandeur. In the shadow of an impending tragedy, your mission is to explore the past and uncover its dark secrets—haunted by surprises, loss, and vengeance. The choices you make ripple through the past and present in the world of Lies of P, revealing hidden truths and leaving lasting consequences.

Embark on an unforgettable adventure where the symphony of steel clashes with the haunting melody of the unknown. Dare to unravel the mysteries of the past, for in the heart of darkness lies the key to unlocking the secrets of a timeless tale reborn.

“Geppetto’s puppet… We need your help.”

name: Yanloveless Simulator
description:
YanLoveLess Simulator is a fangame of Yandere Simulator, developed by @jxstleslie for Windows, Android, and iOS. The game features custom characters in a dramatic high school setting.

Ana Mijlović is a young girl who recently transferred to a prestigious high school. Although seemingly calm and reserved, Ana hides a difficult past and deep emotional wounds. Marked by a tragic event at her old school, she develops a troubled view of love and attachment. Behind her melancholic gaze lies a fierce desire to never lose those she loves again, even if it means resorting to extreme behavior.

In YanLoveLess Simulator, Ana isn't just a rival or an ally: she's a character whose evolution depends on the player's choices. Can she be saved from her obsession? Or will she be consumed by her uncontrollable feelings?

name: Light Up the Town
description: Light Up The Town is a cozy, casual holiday game for all ages. Play as Bean, a precocious young ferret, and explore the town of Bellflower, Colorado as you hang up festive string lights around to spread holiday cheer. Click to throw a light or decoration; the only limit is your imagination.

name: Dogwalk
description: Play as a big adorable dog and explore a hand-crafted winter forest with a little kid in tow. A short, free, open source project brought to you by Blender Studio.

name: Waterpark Simulator
description: Build and run your own waterpark. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

name: Black Souls
description: Black Souls is the censored release of a dark fantasy, souls-like RPG game inspired by Dark Souls and various fairy tales, where you are an unnamed undead who has awakened imprisoned within the Lost Empire. Freed by the brave Holy Knight Jeanne D'Arc, your freedom is short-lived as a fearsome dragon claims both your lives. Now you have one goal - to infiltrate the Lost Empire and defeat Cinderella, who spreads the fog that drains souls and drives everyone to insanity, but to get there, you will need to defeat or enter into a covenant with the Demonic Princesses.

name: Pick me! Visual Novel
description:
"Pick Me!" is an atmospheric visual novel where every choice you make matters.
You decide whether to play as a boy or a girl, and create your character's name to fully immerse yourself in the story.

The plot begins on a dark forest road, where you and your friend face a tough decision — help a dying deer or walk away. From this moment, a chain of events unfolds that will lead you to either a good or a bad ending.

The game combines comedy, light horror, and romance. Expect unexpected twists, mystical scenes, moral dilemmas, and of course, friendship and love.

name: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive
description:
The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege X
description: Rainbow Six Siege X is the reference in tactical team shooters, where elite strategy and execution triumph. Enjoy free access to Quick Match, Unranked and Dual Front game modes with a selection of operators.

name: Peak
description: Peak is a cooperative climbing game for up to four players. After crash-landing on an unknown island, players take the role of scouts attempting to ascend the mountain at its center. The mountain is semi-procedurally generated and changes every 24 hours, featuring five distinct biomes with unique obstacles and enemies. Players manage stamina, collect climbing tools like ropes and pitons, and must work together to survive hazards while ascending.

name: Venue
description: The world is in pieces... this is your responsibility now. The process will be excruciating, beautiful, and you will tolerate it entirely without question.

name: Eighth Day Kishimoto-kun
description: Coming-of-age romance visual novel following a cynical high school student as he discovers the secret eighth day of the week.

name: Hidden Cats in Rio de Janeiro
description: The Hidden Cats continue their world trip and have now arrived in RIO! So let's search for them again. A cozy and relaxing experience to enjoy with your friends and family! Start with a beautiful monochromatic scene, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.

name: Log Away
description: Build a cozy cabin that feels like home. Travel to peaceful Retreats in changing seasons and weather, decorate at your own pace, and collect Keepsakes with gentle backstories. No grind. No pressure. Just nature, animals, and time to breathe.

name: Fever Meme
description: Fever Meme is a comedy/parody game that pivots between multiple genres as it spits in the face of traditional game design. The game is self-aware of your actions as you play, your past mistakes, and so much more. And the further you make it into the game, the more the dynamic between player and creator is explored as the fourth wall is completely stripped away.

name: Vacuous Sugar Quest
description:
Vacuous Sugar Quest is a platformer featuring climbing and gliding mechanics.

Play as Vac, an adventurer trying to climb Sugar Mountain to prove her sugar gliding abilities!

name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 3
description:
A special collaboration with FINAL FANTASY XIV Online, the hit MMORPG, is coming in Title Update 3!
Experience a fanciful story featuring characters who have wandered from the faraway realm of Eorzea—the world of FINAL FANTASY XIV Online.
Get ready for a surge of awesome collaboration content!

name: King of Bones
description: King of Bones is a fast-paced dinosaur fighting game with physics-driven skill-based combat. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through multiple unique game modes and over two dozen unique species as you fight to dominate the arena.

name: SFZ Project: E0 Deluxe Remake
description:
"SFZ Project: Episode Zero. Deluxe Remake" is a complete reimagining of the 2020 mod with updated gameplay and visuals, as well as redesigned Kordon location and various side-quests.

The general plot of the story remains the same - in the Zone there was a third large release, which attracted the attention of Professor Sakharov, who supplied a group of scientists to go to the Chernobyl NPP. The connection with the expedition is cut off and a former mercenary and friend of the professor is sent to the Zone to find out the circumstances.

name: Tung Sahur Zombie
description: Escape a deadly dungeon as Tung Tung Tung Sahur, the last survivor of a brainrot zombie outbreak. Dodge deadly traps, jump through chaotic levels, and reunite with your lost friends in this fast-paced, physics-based 3D platformer full of absurd charm and challenge.

name: Dude Called Barry
description: Run across short fast paced levels, comboing movement abilities to try and get to the finish line as quickly as possible

name: Futa Runner: Big Dick Edition
description: Get ready to dive into the brutal and hardcore futanari underground world!

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Xenogears Pack
description:
A pack of three Xenogears music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Awakening", "Blazing Knights" and "Soaring"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Octopath Traveler Pack
description:
A pack of additional music tracks from Octopath Traveler to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Battle at Journey's End", "Primrose, the Dancer", "Daughter of the Dark God", "Octopath Traveler -Main Theme-" and "Decisive Battle II"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Live A Live Pack
description:
A pack of additional music tracks from Live A Live to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Go! Go! Steel Titan!", "LIVE・A・LIVE", "Birds Fly, Fish Swim" and "MEGALOMANIA"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - The World Ends with You Pack
description:
A pack of additional music tracks from The World Ends with You to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"World Is Yours", "Your Ocean", "Breaking Free", "Twister", "Calling" and "Someday"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - SaGa Pack Vol. 2
description:
A pack of 8 additional music tracks from the SaGa series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"The Celestial Protectors", "Battle #4", "Alone", "Battle #5", "T260G's Last Battle", "Feldschlacht III" and "Mißgestalt"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - SaGa Pack
description:
A pack of 7 additional music tracks from the SaGa series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Enraged Battle", "Struggle to the Death", "The Conflict", "Horrible Shadow", "Beat Them Up!", "Coup de Grace" and "Ardent Rhythm"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Chrono Pack
description:
A pack of 6 additional music tracks from the Chrono series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Wings That Cross Time", "Radical Dreamers -Le Trésor Interdit-", "Chrono Trigger", "Boss Battle 2", "Battle with Magus" and "Corridors of Time"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - NieR Pack Vol. 2
description:
A pack of 6 additional music tracks from the NieR series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Fleeting Words / Outsider", "Song of the Ancients / Devola", "Hills of Radiant Winds", "Kainé / Salvation", "Song of the Ancients / Fate" and "Shadowlord"

name: The Last Gas Station
description: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

name: Entity Scavenger
description: Lethal Company x Minecraft; use your crowbar to open containers to get materials to craft better crowbars to open better containers; all while avoiding monsters!

name: My Splitting Image
description: A psychological horror where you play a man who can no longer even recognize his own reflection, tormented and at the same time welcomed by a mysterious figure with a book embedded in his face.

name: Bulletploop
description: BULLETPLOOP is a 2D platformer, roguelike shmup game. Where you shoot your way through a series of monsters, who are determined to kill you. Although, some odd forces will not let you truly die.

name: M. Stain
description: Journey into a nightmarish world of bizzare people and twisted locales as you unravel the mystery of eccentric business tycoon M.Stain's true nature. Can you get the job? Can you even survive?

name: Wires and Whiskers
description: Wires and Whiskers is a local co-op action-puzzle game where two players control a lab-engineered gerbil and its magnetic exosuit. Work together to fight mutated enemies, solve magnetic puzzles, and survive in a ruined, post-apocalyptic trench world.

name: Dungeon Squire
description: It's a direct descendant of Dragonsweeper, which in turn is a spin of Mamono Sweeper. The game focuses on Android gameplay (touch, small screen size) and uses Kenneys tiny-dungeon assets and sounds from freesound.org.

name: Dead Exhale
description: Make a sound on your mic, and something will hear you. This isn’t your typical monster. He won’t just hunt you, he’ll toy with you. And as you get better, he adapts, evolving to match your skill in this tentacle-infested nightmare.

name: The DeadLine
description: The last subway departs in a world overrun by zombies. At each station, gather materials, find better weapons, and fight off the undead. As you get closer to your family, the danger grows. Survive, upgrade, and make it to the final stop.

name: The Last Ski Trip
description: The main character, travels to a remote snowy valley with his brother for a skiing trip. But soon after their arrival, strange events begin to unfold. What was meant to be a peaceful getaway quickly turns into a nightmare. Over time, he realizes that something terrible is live in the valley...

name: Twisted Gallery
description: You're trapped in an endlessly looping art gallery — familiar, yet uncanny. If you can notice the changes, maybe you can find your way out.

name: Her Trees: Puzzle Dream
description: "Her Trees: Puzzle Dream" is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Unravel the strange puzzles hidden in your dreams.

name: Sense: The Game
description: "Sense The Game" is a unique philosophical game inspired by the myth of Sisyphus, where you are tasked not just with pushing a boulder, but also with seeking answers to life's most profound questions.

name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
description: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

name: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac
description: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC modernizes, updates, and enhances the fan favorite 3D Platforming adventure in nearly every way! Venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the golden fruit and put a stop to the ghosts and their dastardly boss, Spooky!

name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
description:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

name: Octopath Traveler 0
description:
All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra. Embark on a brand new adventure of your own creation in this stunning HD-2D RPG, Octopath Traveler 0!

Brand-new features to the series include a character creation system where you get to become the hero, and town building mechanics as you seek to restore your devastated home.

name: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles - Deluxe Edition
description:
Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles is a tactical role-playing game that features turn-based, grid-based combat with a focus on positioning, terrain, and class-based progression. Players customize a party through a variety of jobs and abilities while engaging in strategy-driven battles.

The Deluxe Edition includes the following bonuses:
・ Weapon: Akademy Blade (Raises a unit's speed attribute slightly while equipped)
・ Headwear: Akademy Beret (Prevents the Charmed status while equipped)
・ Combat Garb: Akademy Tunic (Grants Shell while equipped)
・ Accessory: Ring of Aptitude (Boosts JP earned while equipped)
・ Consumable Items: Phoenix Down x10
・ Black Equipment for Ramza
・ Red Equipment for Ramza

name: Project Kouvola
description: A visual novel about a dystopian country and the things survivors must do to stay alive... The happiest country in the world is now in ruins and only a few remain alive. This couldn't get any worse...

name: Mawkey The Last Macaw
description: Step into Mawkey's shoes and explore the linear world of Honduras, freeing animals and stopping the deforestation of evil businessman Adreim.

name: Cursedland
description: Go on a single adventure, where all the jumps and movements are of importance. You must overcome floating platforms, avoid traps and kill enemies, tearing them to pieces, to make your way through the surreal world of the game, full of fun and challenging references.

name: Well Dweller
description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

name: Geamana Village
description: A first-person investigative game set in a drowned village. Explore abandoned homes, speak with the last remaining locals, and capture through your lens the destruction left behind by the toxic sludge. Gather evidence, follow every clue, and uncover the truth hidden beneath silence and decay.

name: Song of Nanzhao
description: Song of Nanzhao is a music-driven puzzle adventure set in ancient China. As a voiceless court musician, use pentatonic melodies drawn from nature to solve puzzles, uncover hidden stories, and connect with villagers, seeking peace through the power of sound.

name: Necrotyper
description:
Necrotyper is a typing-based action-adventure game with elements of RPG and strategy. The player controls an undead army indirectly by typing spells to support it. There is no direct unit control; gameplay focuses on typing to influence battles.

Typing speed is important to avoid being overwhelmed by enemies, but accuracy also plays a role—mistake-free typing increases spell effectiveness. Spells can be upgraded over time to help manage the increasing number of enemies.

name: Raccoin: Coin Pusher Roguelike
description: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

name: Black Souls II
description:
BLACK SOULS II is the censored release of the Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."

name: Denshattack!
description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
description: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

name: Echoes of Mora
description: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

name: Space Tail
description: Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer that follows an emotional, story-driven journey through the cosmos. Play as a brave space-traveling dog exploring mysterious planets, solving puzzles, and forming unique bonds with alien civilizations along the way.

name: 1348: Ex Voto
description: Journey through a tumultuous Medieval Italy as Aeta, a young knight errant who sets off on a brutal quest to find and save her closest one. 1348 Ex Voto is a cinematic action-adventure game inspired by chivalric tales.

name: Crushed in Time
description: Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click adventure. Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!

name: Super Haste
description: Super Haste is a 3D first-person platformer featuring 11 levels designed for speedrunning. It includes many platforming challenges, easter eggs and awesome music.

name: Train Sim World 6
description: Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes. Unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!

name: No Man's Sky: Voyagers
description: Create your own colossal, fully furnished, completely bespoke Corvette-class starship in No Man's Sky VOYAGERS - and invite your friends on board. Introducing habitable, multi-crew starships assembled from hundreds of ship modules, new multiplayer missions, a stunningly detailed new player suit, a ship-building community expedition - and more!

name: Kaelaverse: Pemascape
description: Kaela Kovalskia of Hololive ID has gone missing! Play as her army of assistants, the Pemaloe, and set off to explore caves, dungeons, and mazes and discover the truth about Kaela's whereabouts!

name: Remains
description: Remains is a hardcore mix of platformer, 2D-shooter and roguelike with RPG elements. Travel around a post-apocalyptic world and explore its various corners, communicate with locals and help them, level up and fight enemies using a vast arsenal of weapons and magic.

name: Darn Guy Adventures
description: Darn Guy Adventures (AKA DGA) is a ~ 4 hour RPG adventure based around attempting to find news about a certain videogame

name: Helping Hand
description: Helping Hand is a VR Puzzle Platform Game where the player has to save a newborn creature from a house haunted by dark presences. Collaborate with the creature, solve the puzzles and escape from the monsters which are hunting it in an adventure that will leave you breathless.

name: Hidden Cats in Istanbul
description: Find hidden cats in the charming and historic city of Istanbul! Start with an uncolored scene and relax as you color the streets, explore landmarks, and meet special furry friends to collect unique cards. A cozy, family-friendly hidden object adventure full of charm and color!

name: Dragon Ball Sparking Zero: Shallot (Dragon Ball Legends)
description: Shallot from the mobile game DRAGON BALL LEGENDS joins the battle!

name: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
description: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is a modern remake of DRAGON QUEST VII, which originally launched on PlayStation in 2000. In this new reimagined version of the game, the core concept of the original title remains, but the battle mechanics, graphics and story have all been updated and improved, providing players with a more streamlined and focused experience. In particular, the graphics in the game were completely overhauled from the original, using real-life doll figures for the characters and monsters that were scanned into the game to create stunning hand-crafted visuals. This definitive version of the game is perfect for fans who want to revisit the beloved story or newcomers who are diving into the world for the first time.

name: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
description: The full remake of FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO II: Crimson Butterfly. This Japanese-style horror adventure game follows twin sisters lost in an abandoned village haunted by evil spirits. Using the Camera Obscura, they fight ghosts as the story unfolds.

name: Pokémon Pokopia
description: Pokémon and people once lived happily together, but the world has withered and the humans are gone. The only remaining resident appears to be a lone Tangrowth. After waking from a long slumber, a peculiar Ditto decides to restore the desolate land using its transformation skills and its surprising new crafting abilities. Play as a Ditto and build a charming world alongside your Pokémon friends. After a satisfying day of crafting, building, and gardening, relax in your very own paradise or invite Pokémon and your friends to visit. As you restore your world and cultivate its natural beauty, you'll encounter more Pokémon who will teach you useful moves! Your Pokémon neighbors are excited to play together, as well as help you build houses to welcome even more friends! Pokémon might even ask for your help – work with them to build a cozy utopia.

name: LinkedIn or Interpol
description: LinkedIn or Interpol is a guessing game in which players are shown photographs and must determine whether the person pictured is a LinkedIn professional or a wanted criminal listed by Interpol.

name: Stanley Says
description: A first-person puzzle horror game set in a defunct children's nursery from 2001. Uncover dark secrets, solve mascot-themed puzzles, and survive the twisted games of Stanley—an animatronic who never stopped playing.

name: FarmD
description: A NSFW furry game for engaging in lewd shenanigans with your dragon friend.

name: Legend of Ymir
description:
Legend of YMIR is a free-to-play, MMORPG inspired by Norse mythology, available on PC and mobile platforms.

Experience the awe-inspiring details of Norse mythology brought to life with Unreal Engine 5. Step into a vivid and immersive world where ancient legends come alive.

Each season introduces new battlefields, stories, enemies, and events. Escape the monotony of fixed systems and embrace the ever-evolving combat that changes moment by moment.

Feel the thrill at your fingertips with intricate controls and convenient automatic systems, redefining the excitement of combat through an immersive hit-confirmation system and evade controls.

Your adventures, your choices. Every action and decision shapes your path, carving out your own unique journey. Start an adventure that begins with you and create a story that only you can tell.

name: Hit It Back
description: The ultimate street-style cricket match has begun! In Hit It Back, you choose a team and defend your neighborhood in a 2D isometric game of brazilian urban cricket against legendary teams, all with the touch of a button. Easy to pick up, hard to put down!

name: Rave Heart+
description: Experience the definitive edition of this classic RPG, now available on the Epic Games Store. Rediscover the adventure, enhanced and reimagined, and relive the thrilling story on a whole new platform!

name: [Herror] Gas Station Case
description:
[HERROR] is a series of short horror episodes where everyday work routines collide with paranormal threats. Each episode is a unique standalone story lasting 1.5–2 hours.

Dan Cooper, a 25-year-old night shift gas station worker in Ohio, recently laid off from a uranium plant, is trying to put his life back together. But everything changes when his friend Michael discovers a mysterious case by the lake. Soon, people begin to vanish in the surrounding woods, and the cozy gas station turns into a deadly trap.

name: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
description: YAKUZA KIWAMI 3 is an extreme remake of the action-adventure beat 'em up Yakuza 3 featuring ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu's fight to protect those he loves. DARK TIES is a brand-new game featuring Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 included as a separate action-packed experience.

name: Recuerdos de Invierno
description: Recuerdos de Invierno is a point-and-click visual novel with hints of dark comedy. The story follows a clown who lives in the backrooms, exploring different episodes from her past. As she wanders through strange corridors and rooms, the player interacts with objects linked to her memories, revealing fragments of her life and personality.

name: Orchard Odyssey: Cherry Chase
description: In Orchard Odyssey: Cherry Chase, you guide Aurora through a single vibrant orchard level to collect cherries. You can run, jump, and unlock new abilities like double jump or enhanced map vision. The map is semi-procedural being shuffled every time you enter the Orchard.

name: The Bar Souls
description: The Bar Souls is a retro pixel souls-like set in a mysterious digital world. Face ruthless bosses, solve puzzles that test mind and heart, and let perseverance unveil hidden secrets on your path to the end.

name: Watcher's Eye
description: The Watcher's Eye is a horror-like game based on the legends of the Dark Web. Your main goal is to survive by spotting as many anomalies as possible on the CCTV cameras. If you have a keen eye for observation then this game is for you!

name: Panopticon
description: Panopticon is a mystery adventure game set in a café part-time job. Uncover the truth under the pressure of surveillance and experience a thrilling story with realistic graphics and immersive interactions.

name: Scritchy Scratchy
description: Scritchy Scratchy is a satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy tons of scratch-off's, buy an auto scratcher to do all the hard work and win jackpots! Will you risk it all for the big reward or play it safe?

name: It's John's House
description: Anomaly-Spotting Horror inside a cursed manor ruled by the twisted lawyer Dr. John Ravenwood, his voice following your every step and decision. Time loops, shifting horrors, and cruel games await. Spot anomalies. Sign his contract… and no, you don’t get another lawyer.

name: Who's Hungry?
description:
After a robot invasion that wiped out most humans from existence, a
human calls to DELIVERYCIOUS, one of the few food delivering services left.
You, a Delibot from the same company, must venture to another planet to deliver your
food. Explore a kilometric building where all kinds of bots will try to steal your food!

name: Floss
description: A fast-paced top-down shooter without any excess. Built on aggressive movement, precise controls, and real challenge. Designed for players who love to learn, adapt, and master mechanics.

name: Red Spider: Vengeance Remastered
description: Fully voiced, with over 530 CGs, and an estimated total playtime of 7-8 hours (approx. 1 hour per route). Homages to classic Hong Kong films and characters based on real-life famous actors immerse you in a deep, cinematic drama. The "Cyclopedia" included in the game provides detailed explanations of which scenes reference which films, and which characters are inspired by which actors.

name: Everything I Know, and Everything I'm Ever Gonna Know
description: An odd little visual novel about life, love, and baseball(?!) — a quiet, heartfelt coming-of-age story told through branching conversations and poetic choices.

name: Cricket 26
description: Featuring the all-new Management Career, a bigger and better Pro Team, in-depth Ashes mode, and expanded control on and off the field from enhanced gameplay and in-depth strategies - Cricket 26 is The Ultimate Showdown.

name: Last Leave
description:
Last Leave is a FPS mixed with towed defense mechanics.

Protect the Orb of Memories moving on its path to find a safer zone, by preventing enemies to destroy it, then by buying towers to secure the next road.

Explore 4 levels in about an hour, in a retro pixelated and nostalgic environment, with the dark and energic metal music from "le Rat de Mars".

name: Doomriderz
description: Drive through zombie hordes. Upgrade your vehicle to drive faster and longer. Drive everywhere to survive and reach the destination. Also, don't forget to drive safe!

name: The Unplace
description: “The Unplace: Escaping The Cursed Place by Facing Different Trials” is a first-person game where you must escape a cursed place by completing a series of trials.

name: The Warrens
description: An atmospheric first-person horror immersive sim where you use an array of unusual items to escape a murderous cult of rabbit-headed men from a nightmare world.

name: Ghostly Acres
description: Ghostly Acres is an idle hotel management game that lets you play at your own pace. Build, collect, upgrade, and grow an old house into a thriving inn for ghostly travelers.

name: HDOS
description: A free-to-use third party client for Old School RuneScape that is restoring HD for the game Old School Runescape.

name: RV There Yet?
description: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

name: Others
description: This is a retro story game about choices and the voices in your head. Unlock new voices, new thoughts, and new endings.

name: Apes Warfare
description: Lead your ape army to victory in APES WARFARE, a modern turn-based strategy game. Command diverse units, outsmart your enemies, and conquer dynamic battlefields. Test your tactics in the solo campaign or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online multiplayer battles.

name: Alentejo: The Tinto & The Ugly
description: Welcome back to the nostalgic Old Alentejo. In this historical 19th-century European western, help Gildo, Dolores, and Pepe in their quest to fight Baron Tinto and his oppressive laws. To do so, you’ll need to cross the historic border, explore new locations, discover more items, allies, and… new enemies! The Tinto has never meant so much to so many people in so many ways!

name: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
description: Explore a wikipedia-like database and solve a small town mystery in Eastern Europe. Step into the shoes of a journalist in the 90s as you sprawl through articles and uncover the secrets that have been laid in front of you.

name: Sleepover: Rewake
description: Sleepover: reWake is a Gay Adult/Yaoi Visual Novel featuring the story of Kano and Aki, two best friends who have drifted apart over the years. Help Kano navigate the two’s changed relationship, and create a special bond with Aki to last forever. One night is all it takes!

name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign. Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, and refined controls, plus three brand-new prequel missions featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability.

name: Oath: There is a You That Remains
description: DLC expansion to vai5000's game oath, a companion to her 2025 album.

name: Evil Pongon Game
description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where you dash, wall-jump, and speedrun through levels while avoiding enemies that steal your riches. Shatter hourglasses to trigger countdown escapes from the wall-phasing ENPHOSO, and face bosses in Undertale-style bullet-hell battles.

name: Leaf It Alone
description: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

name: Dragon Quest HD-2D Erdrick Trilogy Collection
description: Three legendary adventures. One definitive bundle.

name: Z.A.T.O.: I Love the World and Everything In It
description: USSR, 1986. A girl goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, yet not a soul seems to be concerned. Uncover the mystery behind her disappearance and transmit your signal to the universe.

name: Tempus
description: Lead the critters home as a retired Wizard, a caretaker of the world in this charming student project that takes you across floating islands and magical puzzles. Harness the energy of nature to fuel helpful spells. But beware, nature might fight back.

name: Elden Ring Nightreign - The Forsaken Hollows
description:
The DLC will feature two new nightfaring warriors as playable characters:

- Scholar: An academic who walks the Lands Between. Boasting impressive arcane levels, he gains incredible advantages through battlefield observation.

- Undertaker: An abbess who was mandated to slay the Nightlord. Boasting impressive strength and faith, she sends enemies to the afterlife with ruthless efficiency.

It also features the new Limveld enemy type, and a new area: Shifting Earth: The Great Hollow, a great cavity in the depths of Limveld. The hollow is strewn with exotic ruins and temples; sacred towers denoting the remains of an ancient people; and crystals that exude a cursed, life-draining miasma.

name: Ultra Nothing
description: Abstract rule-breaking 2D puzzle platformer with turn-based strategy elements and distinctly erratic pixel graphics.

name: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 2
description: The second episode of the game Scarlet Hollow. Last night you encountered something beyond your understanding - start to investigate the matter with Stella and Kaneeka or forget about that and spend the day with your cousin Tabitha. Either way soon enough you will get in another supernatural event.

name: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 3
description: Yesterday you promised that today you'll participate in ghost hunting at Oscar's house but before that you can spend some quality time with Tabitha and visit Stella's and Kaneeka's friend Reese.

name: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 4
description: Stella is missing after she run off last night. Kaneeka suggests go looking for her. Her mom Sybil wants to meet you in the afternoon to discuss something about the mistery and the clinic is still supernaturally attracting you.

name: Vholume
description: Vholume is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

name: How to Fish
description: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

name: Toilet 8
description: You’re trapped in endless toilets. Watch these stalls carefully—every detail counts. If something’s wrong, turn back. If not… don’t you dare look behind. Or face the fart from hell.

name: Small Mouse Big House
description: You play as Millie, a small mouse on a mission to find food for her kids in a house that's far too big—and far too dangerous. As Millie ventures through the enormous rooms, she’ll face towering obstacles and enemies that dwarf her in size. Can she outsmart these dangers and make it back to her family, or will the horrors of the house overwhelm her?

name: Beercrush
description: BEERCRUSH is a first-person action-roguelike where John Beer must fight his way through various environments to quench his thirst for beer.

name: Pronoun Palace
description: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

name: Wrath of Mynah
description: Wrath of Mynah is a turn-based RPG adventure game that follows the gripping story of The Great Hanyem War. Hundreds of years after Mynah Smith arrived on Hanyem, you play as Pike Gilder, a petty thief who wants to make a difference in the everlasting fight against the tyrannical Indigallo Federation as they lose their grip over their territories. Join forces with a plethora of unique party members, such as Tusk, Liz Fureon, Deven Proditor, Rosie, Nova Acri, and Val Fortis! Collect items, armor and weapons! Uncover the deep history and lore of Hanyem and the human, felibrawno, and gisharen people. Eventually you will be prepared for the ultimate battle against the mysterious General Zed Aurum and King Mynah Smith IX!

name: Money Simulator: Brokeville
description: Welcome to the Brokeville! Grind your way to the top through jobs, deliveries, bicycle races, and risky crypto trades. Buy, customize, and sell cars & motorcycles for profit. Build your own businesses, manage them, and hire staff to grow your empire.

name: Aphantasia
description: Aphantasia is a choice-driven adventure game following Roudert, the Son of Drop, as he ventures across the island of Mollagit to rescue his friend known as The Mouse. Players journey alongside three companions - Largo, Mustaeyed, and Caleidoface - making decisions that shape the narrative outcome while encountering various inhabitants of this peculiar world marked by unconventional characters and dark humor.

name: Samson
description: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

name: Of Me and My Mirror
description: A surreal, emotionally charged visual novel that explores identity, trauma, learning to let go of the past, and moving on.

name: Math Push
description: Math Push is a puzzle game where you move blocks to solve math expressions. Clear the exit by solving the problem and moving on to the next level!

name: Tackle Box: The First Catch
description: Tackle Box: The First Catch is a fishing-action hybrid where you have to fight every catch with your bare hands.

name: The Plant Shop
description: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

name: Cthuloop
description:
Loathsomeness waits and dreams in the deep.

Madness. Frenzy. Loopiness. Succumb to them in the depths of a looping nightmare.

name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - Thank You Update
description: The "Thank You" update is a free major content update, including a brand-new level, “Verso’s Drafts”, featuring new environments to explore, battles to fight, and plenty of surprises to discover. The biome has a very childlike, wonderland-style aesthetic, inspired by Verso’s childhood, but you’ll see more cutscenes that elaborate on this in the update.

name: Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning
description: Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning is a remake of game Nightmare in which Anton has nightmares and finds out what causes them. Of course, in his dreams Anton will encounter many obstacles that he must overcome

name: Berry Bury Berry
description: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

name: Crisis: The Third Way
description: Crisis: The Third Way is a fantastic visual novel set in a world struggling to recover from a devastating financial crisis that led to World War III.

name: It's Fine
description: Idle / Incremental about developing a game with your dog Joe. Unlock unique mechanics, evolve with multi-layered prestige, find secrets, beat all alt endings, and deliver your game on time!

name: Silent Hill Demake
description: A complete game boy color demake of the PS1 classic Silent Hill.

name: Final Fantasy XIII-2: Perpetual Battlefield
description: Get ready for a new episode in the Coliseum! Snow is back and ready to rumble. Win battles and get your hands on the crystal to unlock Snow as a party member!To access this content, enter the Historia Crux (available from Chapter 2 onwards) and select "Coliseum -??? AF-".

name: Final Fantasy XIII-2: Heads or Tails?
description: Unlock new casino content and a new episode featuring Sazh in Serendipity. Complete the episode to gain Sazh as a battle ally. To access this content, enter the Historia Crux (available from Chapter 2 onwards) and select "Serendipity -??? AF-".

name: Trine Classic Collection
description: Experience the magic of the puzzle-platforming Trine series with Trine Classic Collection. Includes four titles: Trine Enchanted Edition, Trine 2: Complete Story, Trine 3: Artifacts of Power and Trine 4: Definitive Edition.

name: The Artisan of Glimmith
description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

name: Twin Shot Deluxe
description: The Angel Cats are back! Twin Shot Deluxe is a platform arcade shooter where players defend their homeland using bow and arrows. Take aim at 200+ brand new levels set across four worlds. Play solo or with a friends in local co-op (1-4 players) or competitively to see who will be crowned champion.

name: Monkey Wave
description: The Ape-pocalypse is here! Survive devastating waves, sharpen your reflexes, and defeat epic bosses in this fast-paced clicker full of PvP, co-op, and non-stop chaos.

name: GraviChess
description: Use the classic chess pieces to work your way through this complex puzzle platformer. Capture all enemy pieces before they get you to beat the 102 intricately designed levels.

name: All Hail the Orb
description:
All Hail The Orb is a quirky and short active incremental game in which you devote yourself to The Orb!
Explore the once lost dungeon as you build your gathering of cultists and bring the dungeon back to its former glory!
Explore and enjoy the light-hearted progression and story!

name: RunGx
description: RunGX is a platformer-like shooter game inspired by Super Haste.

name: Oh Demon! Fix my TV
description: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.

name: O Réquiem das Crianças
description: Following the mysterious disappearance of a child in the Pytaka ecological park, Maranguape, Ordo Realitas decides to send its newest agent: Jaime Ortega.

name: Warhounds
description: Warhounds is a turn-based tactics game about an elite mercenary squad with an old-school action movie vibe, inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance. Recruit unique fighters, upgrade your base, and fight for Africa’s future. No fake RNG - only true ballistics and lethal tactics.

name: Flufftopia: Fluffmazing Edition
description: Flufftopia is a cute little clicker game with a story. Help your town to grow and eventually become Flufftopia! But wait… could there be even more?

name: Drop Duchy: Complete Edition
description: Drop Duchy: Complete Edition includes all additional content released so far (“The Tribe” and “The North” DLCs) bringing the full strategic experience to console players! In a charming, maquette-inspired medieval world, Drop Duchy blends deckbuilding, puzzle mechanics, and roguelite progression into one seamless, strategic experience.

name: Galactic Overthrow
description: Conquer the galaxy in this streamlined space conquest and empire management game. With the heart of a classic 4x experience, but with campaigns that can be finished in one short sitting. Play any way you want: Open ended sandbox, race against bots, multiplayer vs friends, and more.

name: Crown Siege
description: A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom. Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival!

name: Terminal Lucidity
description: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language. Crack the code, unlock the truth.

name: Six Nights in Frenski's Basement
description:
SNiFB is a FNaF fan-game in which you have to survive in Frenski's Basement.

Who is Frenski?
Frenski is a character inspired by the Bulgarian history teacher from TUES - Anatol Frenski.

What do you do in this game?
In this game you have to survive in Frenski's Basement by writing a lot of essays.

name: Devil of the Plague
description:
Devil of the Plague is a 1–4 player co-op horror and survival game set in a dark ritual world.
Play as plague doctors, explore cursed locations, complete rituals, survive infected creatures, and face the ancient demon ASAG. Work together with your team, manage limited resources, and escape before the plague consumes you.

name: The Last Cat in the Universe
description: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

name: Marble Racing Manager
description: Marble Racing Manager is an idle racing game where players collect and manage marbles that compete automatically. Players begin with free gems to purchase their first marble and expand their collection over time. Marbles are placed in a racing tray to enter competitions that occur automatically every 60 seconds, generating rewards without active player input. The game features an idle progression system where marbles continue racing and earning resources while the player is away.

name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
description: Play as the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel. Wield legendary blades, use supernatural abilities, and battle through a world of conflict, intrigue, and prophecy as their paths collide across the dark world of Nosgoth.

name: Neva: Prologue
description: Set years before the events of the main game, Neva: Prologue tells the story of how Alba and Neva first met.

name: Sludgineers
description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

name: Crazy Hotel Together
description: Discover Crazy Hotel Together, a hotel management game where you and your friends have to run a rather unusual hotel! Fulfill your guests’ requests and upgrade your establishment to transform it from a low-cost hotel into a palace!

name: Bunker KYS
description: Survive in a bunker in this intense social game for 4-10 players. Form alliances, manipulate opponents, and vote on who to condemn to certain death. In a stylish low-poly atmosphere, your main weapon will be not strength, but your ability to negotiate.

name: Orchard Odyssey: Chestnut Christmas
description: In Orchard Odyssey: Chestnut Christmas, you guide Aurora through a single vibrant orchard level to collect chestnuts in a Christmas-themed Orchard. You can run, jump, and unlock new abilities like double jump or enhanced map vision. The map is semi-procedural, being shuffled every time you enter the Orchard.

name: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden
description: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

name: Staged
