description: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

name: Ritualist
description: Ritualist is a dynamic isometric action-roguelike set in a unique dark fantasy world. Choose your weapons, master combat style, and face death as you uncover ancient rituals to seal away the Primordial Ones. Will you survive the descent, or will the Abyss claim you?

name: Beyond the Eyes
description: A 2d game with a view from above, where you are in the shoes of a blind protagonist and have to find a way to escape from a mansion by collecting various items scattered around it at random while being chased by a monster.

name: Cherry blossom
description: The game "Cherry blossom" is about a cute little bear who went to save a wise tree from darkness.

name: Fin-Tastic Battle
description: A fixed wave shooter where a lonely old man defends his home from an ancient civilization of orcas that claims the land as their promised territory.

name: DisasterPR+
description: DisasterPR+ is a 3-8 player online party game. In absurd scenarios, bizarre situations, and a table full of meme cards. Not only that, DisasterPR+ is the upgraded version of "Disaster PR"— with smoother gameplay, new artwork, and a revamped interface. The new "Image Mode" lets you use memes or crazy photos to create funny PR disasters. Perfect for parties, streaming, or online fun!

name: Hearth and Hamlet
description: Gather resources and grow your settlement from a humble camp into a vibrant, magic-filled kingdom! Hearth and Hamlet is an incremental citybuilder game in a cozy pixelart style. Assign workers, unlock new buildings, policies, and magic, trade with faraway lands, and construct your ideal settlement!

name: Project - Labyrinth
description: A fantasy turn-based, grid-based dungeon crawler RPG with a blackjack-style card system that drives combat and skill execution.

name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
description: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

name: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
description: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes.

name: Echoes of Aincrad
description:
Step into the legendary floating castle of Aincrad, a realm of breathtaking beauty and unforgiving danger. What seemed to be a dream adventure has now become a fight for survival. Among thousands of trapped souls, your journey is yours alone; will you rise, endure, and forge bonds that define your destiny? Or will you perish while facing enemies stronger, faster, and more ruthless than you imagined?

This is not just a game. It’s a battle for survival.

Take up your weapon. Shape your legend. Conquer Aincrad. RISK YOUR REALITY!

name: Masturbrowse
description:
Curiosity didn't kill the cat, but it will kill 150 million sperm cells.

Created in a few forgetful weeks as a companion piece to Ferarum but it's alright as a standalone too.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Pirate Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Pirate Cat," take control of a pirate cat scaling the deck of a pirate ship. Jump, meow, and collect sardines as you explore every corner of the vessel — from the hold to the crow's nest. How far will your curiosity take you on the high seas?

name: Grand Containment Sector 4
description:
Grand Containment : Sector 4,

"They said it was just a server farm. They lied."

For years, Grand Gaming Technologies Private Limited (GGTPL) has been a leader in virtual entertainment. But rumors have started to circulate on the dark web—rumors of people going missing near their remote "Logistics Center" hidden deep in the forest. They call it Sector 4.

You are a whistleblower who has received a cryptic coordinate. Armed with only a flashlight and a camera, you must infiltrate the decaying industrial complex to find out what GGTPL is really building.

But the factory isn't abandoned. The machinery is still humming, the security protocols are active, and something horrifying is stalking the assembly lines.

Investigate. Survive. Expose

name: Not My Child
description: A psychological horror where a father returns home, only to find toys and haunting notes that whisper a truth he refuses to face.

name: Rooftop Rascal: The Farmer Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Farmer Cat," you're a clever cat navigating a charming farm. Jump across platforms, collect easter eggs, and climb your way from the barnyard to the rooftop. In this special adventure, a special guest is visiting our rascal cat.

name: Project Lunky
description: The player is unwillingly teleported into a lab where everything wants to kill you. Get coins, buy upgrades and find the key to escape. Warfstash is there, Lunky is everywhere, there's a vague reference to Damien somewhere.

name: Odd's Job
description: Jump, bounce, and roll through jobs to unite his family in their new home. Unlock quirky relatives, grab collectibles, and explore differently themed worlds in this wholesome platforming adventure.

name: Skyblitz
description: Skyblitz is a fast-paced helicopter action game with instant, arcade-style control. No sim physics, no wasted time. Engage in explosive, objective-driven missions, outmaneuver missile fire, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens to reignite global war.

name: Love at the RatbagTrash Cabin!
description:
Your car broke down. A kind stranger took you in.
His cabin is lovely. His roommates are lovely.
Everything here is just... lovely.

name: ARES: Automated Relay System
description: In this game you give commands to an Automated Relay System, designed to give detailed reports aboard a spaceship with a crew conducting highly classified research. Due to a few bad calls the situation within begins rapidly deteriorating, with you remaining as the sole hope of survival to the crew still alive.

name: End of Starchild
description: A beguiling first-person shooter with more to explore and exploit the further you sink in. You are Elph, and up until this very moment, you've been drifting aimlessly. A voice reaches out through the haze: "rise and shine." It's time to use your faculties to their fullest.

name: The Birth Cry
description: Mikhail Markov, lives in the city of Nesgrad in Virelia in the 1990s. The city's old maternity hospital, "Riverside Maternity Hospital," has been closed, and many stories and paranormal claims circulate among the public about its whereabouts.

name: Physician of Armiosion
description: The story follows Lexis, a cheeky young doctor, and his partner Patrizia as they battle, explore, and treat patients while investigating the disease that destroyed his homeland. Their path is blocked by those who persecute doctors, religious powers, and unresolved conflicts from the past.

name: Trail & Error
description: A chaotic co-op survival game for 1–8 players where you travel the trail, manage supplies, survive disasters, and argue with friends. Work together to keep the wagon moving, adapt to random events, and try to make it to the end in one piece.

name: Unlucky Mummy
description: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a 25% chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?

name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
description: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

name: Warehouse 30
description: Take on your father's job as a warehouse clerk, inspect each shipment note carefully and direct them to where the corresponding warehouse. Stick to the rules, avoid making mistakes and subsequently fines to make enough money to help your family get through this rough patch.

name: Gibber Babel
description: A puzzle game where a new language is about to take over. Learn as many terms as possible and save the language!

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God
description: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

name: Silent Noise: Prologue
description: Silent Noise is a psychological horror experience by MSP Games, built in the Godot Engine. The prologue demo introduces players to its atmospheric design, emotional depth, and psychological tension—favoring immersion over jump scares.

name: Roman Trahtenberg: V poiskah ideal'nogo anekdota
description: A humorous quest that lets you experience a few days in the life of a famous Russian showman of the 2000s.

name: Mini Lucy
description: Mini Lucy is a 3D platforming adventure where players take control of Lucy, a young girl who has mysteriously been shrunk to only a few centimeters tall after discovering a strange green crystal.

name: Pibcremental
description: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world. Gather resources, build wacky structures and play mini-games to push your production to its absolute limits!

name: Heritage
description: Animount has been seized by Drammul, the Lizard King, and his army. The only one capable of stopping them is Oro, the serpent. Trapped in a cycle of reincarnation, choose Scrolls, skills and equipments, and join powerful Sects in this Auto-Battler Roguelike to defeat Drammul and save Animount.

name: Moldrise
description: You are a foot fungus that needs to reach the roof. Unfortunately you are attached to a person. Meet strange neighbors. Make bad trades. Every run, you learn what you should have done differently.

name: Cat Mail Co.
description: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog, help locals, and unlock new abilities and destinations.

name: Crococo
description: An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York. Go down there and see for yourself. A 90s-style comedy horror game featuring classic single-voice VHS dubbing.

name: Date Math
description:
A dating simulator where the player will be able to romance all kinds of mathematical concepts, ranging from basic algebra to topology.
Features over 25 concepts to date and multiple endings!

name: Click the Button
description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

name: TerraFirmaGreg
description:
The TerraFirmaGreg group of modpacks are a special hybrid of two titans of modding: TerraFirmaCraft (a deep, realistic survival overhaul) and GregTech (an expansive tech mod famous for its realistic chemistry and complex progression). Both have been seamlessly blended together for a stone-age-to-space-age experience.

Are you looking for a longer modpack where every step feels rewarding, and you're constantly building upon previous technologies in a way that feels seamless and natural?
Do you want a modpack where every mod is carefully integrated instead of just thrown in?
Do you dislike magic mods, or want to try a tech modpack that feels less "minecrafty" with its automation?
Or do you just want to try out GregTech without losing years of your life? Then TerraFirmaGreg may be the modpack for you!

TerraFirmaGreg-Modern (for 1.20.1) is a modern iteration built on GregTech Modern. It emphasizes seamless integration of all mods (Create, Ad Astra, AE2) along with a ton of custom content for a seamless and unique experience. This is a more "polished" experience with modern mechanics.

TerraFirmaGreg-Vintage (for 1.12.2) is the classic version based on GregTech CEu. It offers "survival as it should be" - harsh, realistic, and full of challenges, with classic tech mods like Galacticraft and OpenComputers.

Both packs feature natural progression, deep integration, both survival and automation, a non-magic focus, and tons of in-game help in the form of quests and guides so you can easily navigate your way.

name: Sveta Sky AI
description: A short story in the form of a correspondence with the assistant Sveta Sky AI. Can your AI companion become more than just text and sounds? That's what we're about to find out.

name: Beghost
description: BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets with your ghost girl companion Bee, as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more, in a desperate attempt to escape!

name: Thanks for the Soup
description: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

name: A Night at Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
description: Are you ready for the session? Let yourself be hypnotized and dive into the dazzling world of Moka Efti, known from the series *Babylon Berlin*. As a journalist, you’ll follow the clues to a mysterious case at the famous nightclub. But can you trust your memories?

name: The Lost Apartment
description: 'The Lost Apartment' is a photo-realistic bodycam story horror game developed by SDevScares and published on itchio in 2025. The game has around 45-60+ minutes of playtime, featuring an intense horror experience inside an apartment.

name: Trudge
description: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

name: The One Who Runs Away Is Chased
description:
The One Who Runs Away Is Chased

Simple. Cute. Addictively fun!

Take control of your adorable little yellow hero as you run and jump through endless procedurally generated levels. Time your jumps perfectly, avoid falling, and aim for the highest score possible!

Easy to learn but challenging to master, Kaçan Kovalanır is a fast-paced 2D platformer that's perfect for quick play sessions or chasing your personal best.

name: Sticky Business: Seaside Tales
description:
Dive into a relaxing seaside getaway with Sticky Business: Seaside Tales!

Bring the ocean breeze to your cozy sticker shop with over 113 new stickers and colorful variants inspired by sunny beaches, salty waves, sea creatures, pirate treasures, tropical vacations, and peaceful moments by the shore.

Pack heartfelt orders for brand-new customers and discover 10 charming new stories full of surf contests, beach adventures, drifting romances, pirate conventions, summer vacations, and quiet coastal towns.
This DLC includes:

113 new stickers with additional color variants

10 new customer stories about surfing, pirates, summer vacations, and more!

8 new goodies

6 glitter papers

Whether you love turtles, whales, seashells, surfboards, palm trees, or treasure chests, Seaside Tales brings a splash of ocean magic to your sticker business.

name: Quallet 2
description: Quallet 2 is an open world game where you are a criminal in the world of Qualle.

name: T7's Basics in Educational
description: Just don't make anything wrong with this game, because T7 will get angry and try to catch you if you make wrong answers with the ThinkPad...

name: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
description: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

name: Your Happy Place
description: You found My Happy Place. Did I find Your Happy Place?

name: Fate/Grand Order Lostbelt No. 7: Nahui Mictlān
description: Nahui Mictlān is the seventh and final chapter of Cosmos in the Lostbelt.

name: Orbital Checkpoint
description: Orbital Checkpoint is a sci-fi border control simulator. Check alien documents, scan suspicious luggage, detect contraband, and manage your tight budget on station GSA-42. Regulations change daily, but bills for oxygen and coffee always arrive on time. Will you risk letting the Acid Lemons pass?

name: Paver: Tidy Up Together
description: Transform a chaotic area into a satisfying work of art. Follow the paver layout plan and place 4,064 pavers in their correct locations. Work alone or together with friends, develop useful skills, and restore the plaza piece by piece.

name: Rookie Reaper
description:
Rookie Reaper is a top-down RPG made for android, where you play as a reaper on his first day on the job!
Explore an open world RPG where you play as a reaper with the goal to harvest five corrupted immortal souls, aspiring to become a renowned reaper.
The Combat: A Soulslite experience, fight strong foes, learn their moves and act accordingly.
The Customization: Find your own way to play, level your stats, change your weapon, skills and visual in a way that matches your playstyle.

name: The Shadows Of Eldergroove
description:
20 years have passed since Agent Rebecca went missing.

The Fresterous Police Department gave up and the world moved on. But Sarah, the daughter of the lead investigator, Agent Rebecca, refuses to let the mystery rest. Firing up her car, she arrives in Eldergroove, a forsaken place where an entire town vanished without a trace.

Is she alone?

name: Fate/Grand Order: Realm of the Thanatos Impulse, Traum - Life and Death of an Illusion
description: Traum is the penultimate (6.5th) main chapter of Fate/Grand Order: Cosmos in the Lostbelt.

name: Splat! 2
description:
The smash hit slingshot game is back - and it’s gone rogue!

Splatter your way through all new wild worlds where every shot could be your last! Splat! 2 takes the satisfying chaos you loved and evolves it to the best modern rogue-like experience. Each play through is a whole new delight with all new skills and characters to upgrade! Can you find the best skill combo to be the best?

name: Fate/Grand Order: Cosmos in the Lostbelt - Prologue
description: The prologue chapter of Cosmos in the Lostbelt. Chaldea begins to slow down their operations after resolving all the remaining Singularities. When their new director Goredolf Musik arrives with an entourage of guests, the organization and its staff undergo a thorough investigation, leaving the fate of Chaldea up in the air.

name: Factorized
description: A 2D side-scroller about killing robots with janky guns as a morally questionable main character.
